notes.title: Guilds: A 3D Artist's Work
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/076301d0f42951eb6996f380d8f70006cf3b032d.jpg[/img]

With the arrival of guilds in the game, many island skins are available to customize the atmosphere at your HQ. This article takes a look at the work of a 3D artist, who structures, arranges and makes believable the world we explore in the game.

 

[b]Can you introduce yourself to the community and tell us how you ended up here and the like?[/b]

Hi, everyone! I'm Yuguhtrrh, and I've been a 3D artist on the WAVEN team for three years now. My rather unusual nickname actually comes from an entirely random combination of letters when I was playing a Flash game as a kid and had to name my character – and it's stuck with me ever since!

 

I've been a huge fan of Ankama's games and series as long as I can remember. In high school, I played – like lots of teens do – lots of games that, little by little, made me want to work in this field. I went on to study at E-ArtSup in Toulouse, France, where I found a mentor who helped me gain confidence in my chosen path.

 

After two years of intensive study and many personal projects, I was lucky enough to get an internship at Ankama! It was a very enriching experience and after my third year of study, I applied for a job as a 3D artist. When I'm not working, I play lots of sports, have an obsessive love of chocolate croissants (or [i]chocolatines[/i] as we call them here*), and can't resist cute animal videos.

 

[i](Editor's note: No, we don't call them that here. Those are fighting words.)[/i]

 

[b]Can you tell us what a typical workday looks like for you?[/b]

My day starts with a quick talk with the artistic director about current work, to make sure we're on the same page. Then, I get my first cup of coffee… and usually not my last! While my software is opening, I take a take a couple of minutes to keep abreast of what's happening in the arts to spark inspiration, and then I get to work.

 

My responsibilities have grown since I joined Ankama. At first, I mainly handled 3D, but little by little, I've been able to branch out to other areas – level design, item optimization, bug fixes, animated illustration, and even design. I try to always have fun when I'm creating, because I believe it's communicative and can be felt in the game.

 

[b]What teams do you work with most often?[/b]

As a 3D artist, I get to work with every link in the production chain. For example, I regularly work with the animators who sometimes ask for adjustments to the background or decor to better suit the needs of their scenes.

 

Talks with game designers are frequent, too. When they plan new zones or maps, they have a set of specifications including the size of the board, the theme, the atmosphere, and even certain environmental constraints. We often need to coordinate with the artistic director, game designers and developers to asses feasibility and assign tasks. I also work regularly with the developers, either to discover new tools that will simplify production or to optimize the 3D environments.

 

Finally, our 3D team has modelers and designers. The modelers do the initial modeling and import the assets into the game, and the designers take care of the finishing touches – textures, colors, atmosphere, etc. Our artistic directer oversees it all, and provides feedback to harmonize everything.

 

[b]Can you explain the creation process for a map or 3D asset?[/b]

To create a 3D asset, we start with a 2D concept that we import into 3D software to start modeling. After several passes, our artistic director examines the model and suggests adjustments to harmonize the shapes. Once this back-and-forth stage is done, we move on to optimization, removing certain polygons to make the model lighter in the game engine. It's a real balancing act because there need to be enough polygons for the outcome to look good, but not too many so the asset doesn't hog resources.

 

The, we move on to [i]UV unwrapping[/i] to prepare for painting the texture; it's a little like unfolding the sides of a cube. The details are projected from the "detailed model" to the "optimized model" to get a quality result without putting too much of a load on the game motor. The texture, composed in intermediary software, updates on the object after it's imported into the game. And there you have it – the asset is ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f48952a677c84ffd33ba60a9c8085f31d189199b.png[/img]

When I need to design an object, all the stages are the same, except that I do the initial concept work myself. The goal is to create items that are instantly understandable and credible, and if possible amusing or cute! Since design isn't my main activity, it takes more effort but the results are very often gratifying (at least for me…).

 

For maps, for example, let's look at the Guild Havens, the last major project I worked on. To start, I was given level design specifications with instructions on the size of the map, activities available there, and their respective positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/90b7e170688eb8aa63c902a09f1ae1478663e3a7.png[/img]

First, I follow the concept by quickly pulling together the map elements and positioning things of interest to define the overall layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/c8deff67422765a138896b991a7452147499eddd.png[/img]
 

Then, the level art work begins, to make the map more alive and more attractive. I flesh out each area of the map individually (the port, the oak tree, the cage, the house, etc.), zooming in and out to adjust the details and overall harmony. It's an iterative process to find the right balance so that the map is neither too empty nor too busy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/1399654bf00573e3905f8a0fb8e5a00702f05532.png[/img]

Composition is a key element because that's when distributing mass and focus points (also called "points of interest") comes into play. For example, we need to avoid creating "tangency issues", that is situations where two objects are so close that their tangents collide or overlap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/35b93632056f24d9cb4a0996e0b2c169445f5b09.png[/img]

After the elements are in place, a designer goes over my work to adjust the colors. This is an important stage because it sets the atmosphere and evoked emotion, and lets us direct peoples eyes where we want. Colors are generated through the lighting or directly on those of the object itself. The goal is to find a balance so that the result is harmonious and nice to look at. I usually provide the design team with a color base and, since they are incredibly talented, we are able – together – to really enhance the map and make it credible in the universe. I hope that players like the different guild islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/fdbc9a660924c0434a2a356eb7f935ab311a8df9.png[/img]
 
Before
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a9530a953553dacf8dd34ef381f5ffdde5fa6974.png[/img]

After
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a1527a33554da1df8e2d976a877e9a2a3afcb413.png[/img]

[b]What was your inspiration for the maps you've created? Did you include hidden references or private jokes?[/b]

Each Guild Haven has it's own theme, so I took my inspiration from lots of things: the Ankamaverse (of course), games I play (Elden Ring, for example), things that happen to me in real life, and even conversations with colleagues.

 

Personally, I really like the Vampyre Guild Haven. I wanted to avoid the "blood-loving Vampyre" cliche and explore how they harvest "blood-wine". That's when the idea of enology hit me. I imagined the path from tasting to harvest, maceration and rest after properly "appreciating" the beverage. There's a whole story I try to tell in my art. The position of the oak tree in the south-west of the map is inspired by the dragon blood tree, which seems perfectly suited to harvesting blood-wine!

 

There are references in almost all the maps, but here are a few just for fun… For each Guild Haven, the instruction was given to add a thematic banquet based on the monster families. For Chafer Island, I found myself imagining what those (almost) living skeletons could eat… What makes bones stronger? Calcium!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/2507f0a94484cedfa4a46b3aee2e8762eb0ff8e9.png[/img]

Another reference is on the Gobball Guild Haven. The number 10 on the gobbowl stadium is a wink at Yugo's headgear during the Real Gobbly game in the WAKFU anime.

 

Obviously, there are more – more or less subtle – references but I'll let the players have fun finding them all!

 

[b]What tools do you use in your work?[/b]

We use Blender for modeling, XNormals for baking (projecting details on the optimized model), Photoshop for textures, and Unity for the game engine. I also always have a sketchbook at hand for notes and sketches and, of course, I've always got a (huge) cup of coffee.

 

[b]Are all the background elements in 3D, or are some in 2D?[/b]

Good question! Everything is in 3D except for certain elements we call "sprites". Sprites are flat surfaces with transparency on which a pattern is applied. For example, in the Crackler Guild Haven, the rails are made of flat sprites. Technically, it's not really 2D because the plane is in 3D, but since it only has two dimensions (X and Y), it gives the impression of being in 2D. You just need to put the sprite on a flat surface for it to naturally blend into the environment – provided that the texture can credibly create a feeling of volume.

Use of sprites varies according to needs. Here, they let us avoid adding too much volume everywhere so that the screen doesn't get too "cluttered" and that the decor element stays discreet. It's a way to optimize the appearance without disrupting readability. We call that a "decal".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/378e9abd02626bed6700c0c5e9265c3ea23d9e98.png[/img]

[b]Do you have any advice for any aspiring 3D artists reading this?[/b]

Giving out advice is a huge responsibility, especially since I'm still new to the industry! But I would say… Don't blindly follow everything you hear; you need to pay attention to what inspires you and suits you. Patience and perseverance are two essential virtues, and you should never hesitate to ask for feedback on your work.

 

Also, I think that it is more useful to master one area fully rather than scattering your efforts. Finally, joining artistic communities on social media can really speed up your progress.

 

[i]Thank you, Yuguhtrrh, for your time and for revealing some of your secrets.[/i] If you want to see more of his work, he updates his ArtStation portfolio regularly:

 

[url=https://www.artstation.com/yuguhtrrh]artstation/yuguhtrrh[/url]

notes.title: Rogue Season: Your goal? Fill your pockets!
notes.notes:
Billie Queen's gang has struck again, with the [b]heist of the century![/b] Until [b]December 17,[/b] relive the historical Bonta bank heist in what is shaping up to be an explosive season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/2ea01054e2b60b93da0df3e8366a806c2d97a36c.jpg[/img]

A Rogue's life isn't an easy one – mainly because it depends on what they can steal from others, and that admittedly is downright dangerous. When you see them, it's usually too late to run away. Their philosophy can be summed up with one rule – probably the only rule they follow – "If it's yours, it's mine!" And if you so much as think the opposite might also be true, you'll end up missing a few teeth.

 

After the Great Wave, some tried to diversify their activities to fit into the new society. Their first idea wasn't all that bad – bomb fishing. But after a strange series of "unlucky" – so they said – merchant ships exploding and the cargo disappearing "as if by magic", the activity was banned. The result? They went back to what they do best: stealing, trafficking, pillaging, and of course… illegally blowing things up.

 

Rumors were rife that [b]Billie Queen[/b] is getting ready for something big, but no one expected a plan that daring… A member of the [b]Billy Clan[/b] and a specialist in spectacular "big clean out" operations (as she likes to call them), she went all out. Discretion? No so much. For her, the bigger the explosion, the louder the bang, the better the show! And it's the [b]Bonta safe[/b] that'll be center stage… this time.

 
[h2][u]Money, Money, Money![/u][/h2]
Leading an elite gang, her "brothers-in-bombs", Billie Queen knows exactly who to pull into her audacious and lucrative plan. [b]You'll be calling the shots for this gang of thieves,[/b] each of which is an expert in their field: [b]Billy Bob[/b] is the fastest at pocketing kamas and slipping away; [b]Billy Kid[/b] has a real gift for relieving his colleagues of too-heavy purses while giving them a second wind; [b]Billy Kroger[/b] can fleece his enemies better than anyone else; and [b]Big Bill,[/b] a beefy brute whose strength speaks for itself. And, of course, [b]Billie Queen,[/b] the brains of the operation.

 

[b]Your goal? Fill your pockets![/b]

 

To earn the title "heist of the century" and make it to the front page of the island gazettes, you'll have to show perfect [b]coordination[/b] to amass [b]as many piles of kamas as you can[/b] and [b]get them out of the bank[/b] in record time. [b]Six turns[/b] – that's all you have to pull off the perfect heist. Careful, though. [b]Bags of kamas are heavy[/b] and each Rogue can only carry [b]five[/b] at a time. The [b]guards[/b] aren't going to sit by and do nothing, either. They'll keep calling in reinforcements to stop you from making off with the coveted coins.

 

[b]Will you be able to guide Billie Queen's gang to their biggest haul yet, or will your career as a criminal mastermind be cut short?[/b]

 
[h2][u]Get Your Fill of Roguish Business![/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/03c3c47845228dd0d1b838607cec38f34664caa7.jpg[/img]

The Rogue saying "never put all your bombs in one basket" is so well known that their clan decided to branch out into sales, putting a few of their creations on the market. As you've probably guessed, the practice was quickly banned. Clearly, compliance with safety norms "might" not have been as stringent as it could have been – yes, there were "unlucky" explosions involved. That said… With the [b][u]Platinum Pass[/u],[/b] you'll have access to Rogue goods of "indisputable"* quality (in their words). And it'll be perfectly legal, too: a [b]Boombot pet,[/b] [b]Rogue Hood headgear,[/b] and even [b]Time Bomb tracks.[/b] A full [b]56 items[/b] await your perusal starting today in the [b]in-game Shop![/b]

 

[i]* Seriously, don't even try… and if you do, don't say we didn't warn you…[/i]

notes.title: God Xelor Kit: Tell the Hours that I'm Out of Minutes!
notes.notes:
From [b]November 12 to 9:00 a.m. (CET) on November 26,[/b] challenge the inevitable and take control of the hands of time with the God Xelor Kit! Xelor's Divine Clock will unveil its secrets with the [b]weekly rotation in the WAVEN Shop…[/b] Hurry, because time is ticking away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a9a808023b397c2b0087e31f97c761c643e81f70.jpg[/img]

Driven by curiosity, Xelor spent time contemplating the pulsations of the six Primordial Dofus and, inspired by their tempos, he created the Divine Clock which shaped the flow of time into something rigid and irrevocable. Thus, the year 0 was born, marking the advent of the passing of time – that precise instant where the past and the future intertwine in the World of Twelve.

 

The disciples of Xelor are the faithful guardians of this temporal web, capable of suspending the present and exploring the past to reshape the future. However, twisting the order of things is always a risky business; force things too far and you can be lost, with just a fraction of an hour, instead of changing everything…

 

[b]Disciples of Xelor, don't let your mind wander elsewhere![/b]

Join the ranks of WAVEN's legendary heroes and set the tempo with the [b]God Xelor Kit,[/b] containing:
[list]	[*][b]Xelor's Helm[/b] headgear[/*]	[*][b]Desynchronisation[/b] halo[/*]	[*][b]Minute Hand[/b] trail[/*]	[*][b]Clock Gears[/b] tracks[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/2d3737585dbcd8f64eaaf59a4b8fc4d150fddc48.png[/img]

Offered at the low price of just [b]1,400 gems[/b] (instead of 2,400, a 42% discount), this [b]complete Kit[/b] is only available for a [b]limited time![/b]

 

Time is capricious but its secrets are within your reach. Give yourself the allure of the god Xelor by heading to the [b]in-game Shop;[/b] don't let time tick away.*

[i]Of course, it will continue to tick-tock along, but at least you'll be looking good as it does![/i]

notes.title: Horrific Kit: Terrifically Horrifying Effects and Frightful Costumes!
notes.notes:
[b]From October 22 to November 5[/b], run, limp, crawl, whatever it takes… but get yourself to the safety of the Shop and get what you need to defend yourself in this wildly spooky season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/5f032bebe1310fe67a306b40619eef5f294705f1.jpg[/img]

Spirits and spooks, ghoulies and ghosties, creatures of the night and other eerie masked figures are gearing up to show their [b]fangs,[/b] [b]scythes[/b] and other gardening tools to come at you with possessions, commotions and lacerations… basically, a whole long list of things ending in [u]-ions[/u] likely to put a few dings in your bodily integrity!

 

No one can really explain why it's the same thing every year, but it seems everything started in the vegetable patch of a certain [b]Al Howin…[/b] But we don't want to focus on ancient history, nor on the long list of past incidents (that no one really remembers)… Instead, we just want to give you [b]a way out![/b]

Give your friends and your enemies a spooky scare with the [b]Horrific Kit[/b] containing:
[list]	[*]a [b]Spider Web[/b] halo[/*]	[*][b]Jack-O-Lantern[/b] headgear[/*]	[*]a [b]Trailing Spirit[/b] trail[/*]	[*][b]Undead[/b] tracks[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9a1fcec76d13ceb0d06f53cc8d1eff0a671e9c2e.png[/img]

This [b]complete kit[/b] is offered at the low price of just [b]1,400 Gems[/b] (instead of 2,400, a 42% discount) for a limited time ([b]from October 22 to November 5[/b] only)! After that, it'll be available at its regular price of 2,400 gems.
[b]But that's not all![/b]

The best way to survive a fright is… to be the fright!

You've got plenty of spooky delights to choose from with these [b]5 skins from the Horrific collection:[/b]

[h2]Headless Tamashi (Tamashi Amber)[/h2][u]Out-of-place in both Incarnam and Externam, Headless Tamashi carved out a pumpkin and in so doing figured out how to stay in the material plane.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e4bb4c9ed850241f5896d437a576de0b3d7f7cb4.png[/img]

[h2]Somber Rose (Brutal Fairblade)[/h2][u]Whoever pricks themselves on Somber Rose's thorns gives her a sip of eternity.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a5128973cdc257015d5d5c283c7cd7d22cffb74a.png[/img]

[h2]Night Claws (Surokan Shiv)[/h2][u]A creature of the night and spooky spots, Night Claws is all darkness and obscurity. But he will point you toward the light at the end of the tunnel.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/4bef69dd8595a5e435b3bf8a3e1df00299ea1e65.png[/img]

[h2]Sneaky Trickster (Buneblade)[/h2][u]Laughter makes everything better. With Sneaky Trickster, you'll die laughing (but die all the same).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/404fd939f1489a4c221029744b2386e5ea37a9d0.png[/img]

[h2]Terror Mask (Pikuxala Hand)[/h2][u]Sometimes, he doesn't even need to show his real face to give his victims the (last) scare of their life.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/c0ba645fd40c3ce54c292f8c8cdb4d3dc8662b2b.png[/img]

Each Horrific skin is available at the special discount price of [b]960 gems[/b] (instead of 1,200 gems) [b]from October 22 to November 19,[/b] after which they'll be available at their regular price.

notes.title: Echoes of Past Seasons: Cosmetic Items
notes.notes:
Cosmetic items from the past have made their way [b]back into the Shop.[/b] If you missed them the first time around, now's your chance to get them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f3f4bd1aa4ce644fe67a5e3a79ff871cd2e1a414.jpg[/img]

Since the WAVEN Early Access first launched, a large number of cosmetic items have been added, allowing you to customize your characters based on season themes. The castaways that have been around the longest have been able to don the Royal Gobball Cape or make the Whisperers' enchanting trumpets sing with every step they take – such delightful melodies that almost explain the Cracklers' sad fate…

 

Until now, once the season was over, those treasures became inaccessible, leaving collectors and new arrivals (notably since the release on mobile) a bit frustrated. However, we want to make sure everyone can get them if they want, [b]cosmetic items from past seasons will be available in the in-game Shop again one year after their release.[/b]

 

[b]When? Now![/b]

 

With the exception of cosmetic items from special seasons* (like [u]Lance Dur[/u], [u]WAKFU[/u], etc.) that will only be back occasionally and pets, the world effects, combat effects, companion skins and emotes will regularly find their way back into the Shop throughout the seasons.

 

[b]To start things off in style, starting today, you can find the cosmetic items from the Gobball, Bwork and Pig seasons in the in-game Shop![/b]

 

[i]* "Special seasons" are seasons that came in several chapters or, sometimes, marked a particular highlight or transmedia theme.[/i]

notes.title: Check Out Guilds in WAVEN
notes.notes:
We had spoken about it at the start of the year during the [b]KrosmoNote 2024[/b], and we showed you the hub (without customizations) during a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2343650?emclan=103582791473570552&emgid=4274565771165677884]livestream at the Ankama Convention[/url].[/b] Guilds have entered the game with version 0.21.0 of WAVEN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a7f85c226356683a019921464438b9cc0f612c44.jpg[/img]
 

To unlock the feature, players must earn at least 150 Quest Points (QPs) in the world. Once they've reached this threshold, a popup window appears letting them know that they can now create a guild or join an existing guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/d0ba3ac3f5b1fe35f3404d749139dd997073d713.png[/img]
 
[h2][u]Access and the Guild Interface[/u][/h2]
Guilds can be accessed from the main menu (located in the lower left of the screen) on PC and from the hamburger menu on mobile devices. If you aren't yet a member of a guild, this button will redirect you to the creation or application interface. Once you've joined or created a guild, this button will let you know when there's something new to see.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/cfe8143f4784b88dc0cc0cc1714ebf68f4127b7e.png[/img]
 
[h2][u]Creating or Joining a Guild[/u][/h2]
To create a guild, you'll need to choose a name, an associated tag (maximum 4 letters) and mode of access (open, on application, or closed); set the minimum level to join (from level 1 to level 50) and main discussion language; write a welcome message; and design an emblem for the guild (shape, logo, background texture and colors). Note that creating a guild costs 25,000 kamas, and a purchase confirmation will confirm the creation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/91bbc7ff3d9c959ee427b236d75852dfb6c4d152.png[/img]
 

If you click on Join (a guild), a search interface opens and shows the list of existing, open Guilds (whether by application or not); you can filter the list by name, level, language and number of members. You can apply to several guilds at the same time, but once one of them accepts you, the other applications will be cancelled automatically.

 

When a player clicks on Apply, they are redirected to a new window where they can write their application message (one hundred (100) characters maximum). Players may apply to several guilds, but they can only join one. Applications are visible to all guild members, and guild members can vote for or against them, but the guild leader and their captains are the only ones who can accept or reject applications.

 

[u]You cannot create or join another guild with a different character on the same account if one of the characters on the account already has or is a member of a guild.[/u]

 
[h2][u]Managing Members[/u][/h2]
Once you are part of a guild, the "Members" tab lets you consult the list of other members, their connection status, and their rank within the guild. The leader and captains can manage members by promoting, demoting, or excluding them as needed. Detailed information on each member can be seen at any time.

 

The rank system lets you choose captains who have – almost – the same privileges as the leader, with the exception of passing on the role of leader. A notification system informs members of each rank change, addition, or exclusion.

 
[h2][u]Guild Challenges and Progression[/u][/h2]
Guilds can level up through four main activites:
[list]	[*][b]Roll Call:[/b] Every day, guild members can click on the "Here!" button to earn XP for the guild.[/*]	[*][b]Dungeons:[/b] The guild's XP will increase as its members successfully complete dungeons.[/*]	[*][b]Saka Patataur:[/b] This is a new weekly challenge specifically for guilds (see below in this devblog for more details).[/*]	[*][b]Number of Members:[/b] The larger guilds are, the faster they progress.[/*][/list]
 

The maximum level for a guild is 50 and bonuses are unlocked every five levels, alternating between XP gains and extra kamas as fight rewards. In addition, each major level threshold provides access to additional slots in the Guild Shop.

 
[h2][u]Guild Island[/u][/h2]
This is the main hub for the guild, accessible only to guild members. The island has various activities, such as the Pirate Merchant (Guild Shop) who offers rare items that can be useful in your progression, a space devoted to conversations (it's lovely to gather around a nice campfire), and the notorious Saka Patataur, the guild's daily target.

 

You can customize your Guild Island with Guild Island skins. All the skins are visible and do not need blueprints. Any player can buy Island skins for the guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/bdf6ab0bcd01340f88160220f22fc5f410124cd6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a2d66ad0870e311cd3010671c801b77b1aeb95a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/495236336f80e93dd78ed212ba3be4373ed279fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/ab6114c529e4a49af9f81dc7b4c84f95dad044f6.png[/img]
 

[u]Important: These skins are unlocked for the guild and not the purchaser's account. In addition, only the guild leader can change the island's appearance. In other words, if you leave the guild, you'll need to buy the skin again.[/u]

 
[h2][u]Saka Patataur[/u][/h2]
Every week, you'll need to do as much damage as possible to him in just a few turns. All the guild members' scores are added up to determine the guild's final results. An intra-guild ranking shows everyone where they rank in relation to their fellow guild members, and an inter-guild ladder ranks guilds against each other with rewards up for grabs for all guild members.

 

This first version of the Guild feature will, later, be improved and fleshed out based on community feedback and our ambitions for the feature.

 

[b]Unite, castaways, and help your guild prosper in the World of Twelve![/b]

notes.title: Vampyres seem to be out for blood – yours!
notes.notes:
An ominous veil has fallen over the World of Twelve, plunging it into worrying darkness. On the horizon, vesperal glimmers dance on the ocean, but something isn't right. Your ears can just make out shrill scrapes and thuds… It's already too late! The thirsty [b]Vampyre[/b] court has chosen you as its prey! Until [b]November 19,[/b] avoid their sharp fangs… or be their next feast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e4ef4a0ab24086a694dd6972e662970565105129.jpg[/img]

Do you believe in the Eternal Night, when dawn never comes? Some swear that it's just a myth. Others whisper that it is real, that one night, the sky will go dark, the promise of a new dawn will be broken, and Vampyres will be the only ones who prosper.

 

Normally, these monsters only set sail within the mysterious Bermuda Triangle – a zone infamous for many sad disappearances – staying aboard their sinister World-Boat, lost in perpetual darkness. It is rumored that some adventurers have, despite themselves, come alongside this enigmatic ship at sea – but never of their own free will. Coincidence? Perhaps… Banished from the lands of the World of Twelve because of their way of (un)life, they remind all those who dare hunt them that "Night is coming!" The naive take it for a mere banality, while others see it as a far darker threat…

 

[b]You should have listened to the latter. You've been taken prisoner! Can you make it out of the Time Portal in one piece?[/b]

 
[h2][u]Mess Is Served![/u][/h2]
 

[b]Don't be fooled, it [u]is[/u] time to eat. Eat what? You, of course![/b]

You're a [b]Prisoner,[/b] caught in a macabre recipe and forced to survive [b]10 turns[/b] against purebloods who want only one thing: to slake their voracious thirst. If you hope to get away, you'll need to think strategically and manipulate the field to your advantage.

 

[b]Spread their favorite beverage[/b] on the ground to wake them up and better distract them. [b]The more the ground is soaked,[/b] the more the Vampyres will delight in it… and the more [b]points you can rack up by eliminating them![/b]

 

[b]Keep careful count of the puddles you spill because, in addition to mere Ghouls and Vampyres, other much more terrifying threats lurk…[/b]

Use [b]Vials of Poison[/b] to make lethal traps and wield your [b]Stakes[/b] with precision to set off [b]fatal collisions.[/b]

 

[b]You just might survive this infernal night… or maybe you'll encounter something absolutely terrifying announcing that a succulent feast is about to start![/b]

[h2][u]Well-Deserved Treasures![/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e3cc8684e332b7696b350e0daf21a27be1ef122f.jpg[/img]

Given the many disappearances for which Vampyres are the only suspects, there's nothing surprising in seeing so many valuable items scattered about on their World-Boat, abandoned by their owners…

With the [b][u]Platinum Pass,[/u][/b] you might, perhaps, collect a few of them. After all, who's going to miss them? A full [b]56 treasures[/b] could enrich your collection and make you very happy: a [b]Borbat pet,[/b] [b]Dame Ocles Wings headgear,[/b] or even a [b]Shrill Ascent halo…[/b] [b]If you head to the game Shop now,[/b] you'll get some great deals! Because even though Vampyres usually take without asking, it seems they can also be generous in death.*

 

[i]*Or was that "with death"? Hmm... Maybe that's not such good news after all…[/i]

notes.title: Goddess Eniripsa Kit: Healing Words!
notes.notes:
Choose your words carefully from [b]September 24 to October 8 at 10:00 a.m. (CEST).[/b] The [b]Goddess Eniripsa kit[/b] is now available! The weekly rotation in the WAVEN Shop is glowing with an aura of wellbeing, and the goddess's wings could carry you to new adventures…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9d03a14d4ba091c60c20a73773b749fb8be850de.jpg[/img]

In the olden days, the goddess Eniripsa traveled the skies of the World of Twelve, spreading wellbeing to her followers and giving them the ability to heal and protect injured souls. Her gentle, healing whispers brought hope to those who believed in her. Heirs to her infinite compassion, Eniripsas make wonderful allies in battle. When all seems lost, a whispered word, a gentle touch, or a grace-filled thought from them is enough to reignite the spark of life. When Eniripsa is watching, despair evaporates and fatality recedes.

 

[b]Lovers of pretty words: each murmured syllable can alter the course of destiny![/b]

Join the ranks of WAVEN's most legendary heroes and shine on the battlefield with the Goddess Eniripsa Kit, which contains:
[list]	[*]Eniripsa Tiara [b]headgear[/b][/*]	[*]Healing Aura [b]halo[/b][/*]	[*]Eniripsa Wings [b]trail[/b][/*]	[*]Healing Flask [b]tracks[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/25bdb52d69118ac82f2d4ec2047aaa9949f182ed.png[/img]
 

Offered at the low price of just [b]1,400 Gems[/b] (instead of 2,400, a 42% discount), this complete Kit is only available for a limited time!

 

[b]Eniripsa herself is reaching out to you. Head to the in-game Shop to don the allure of Enripsa and be a shining light* that pushes back the shadows when all seems dim on the battlefield…[/b]

 

*Just don't shine too brightly. You wouldn't want to cast shade on the goddess herself.

notes.title: Ultimate Kit – WAVEN x Ripper
notes.notes:
Until [b]10:00 a.m. (CEST) on October 22,[/b] don [b][u]Ripper[/u][/b]'s emblematic armor in the World of Twelve thanks to a brand-new [b]limited-edition[/b] [b]Ultimate Kit,[/b] available in the [b]WAVEN Shop![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/72102a48bbf17a6bcfcf07889f4df131339a7ae7.jpg[/img]

Since winning the [b]"Daruma de la French Touch" prize[/b] in 2024, Jeronimo Cejudo has been on an unstoppable roll! This famous mangaka, known for his hard-hitting [u]Ripper[/u] mangas, continues to impress fans with the release of the highly anticipated volume 4, published by Ankama Éditions. But wait, there's more! He has also teamed up with us for a [b]new collaboration[/b] to delight the WAVEN castaways.

 

Who's in the spotlight? [b]Shugen Flayer![/b] This hero now has two new skins and two world effects, available in [b]Ultimate Kit[/b] format:
[list]	[*]a [b]feminine Shugen Flayer skin[/b] (Ripper's armor)[/*]	[*]a [b]masculine Shugen Flayer skin[/b] (Ripper's armor)[/*]	[*]a [u]Ripper[/u] [b]trail[/b][/*]	[*]a [u]Ripper[/u] [b]halo[/b][/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/1085aabcec7672e5583627b0e04068c8e2290cd8.png[/img]
 
True fans will undoubtedly recognize Junk's mask…

 

This [b]Ultimate Kit[/b] is available for the exceptional price of [b]2,500 gems[/b] instead of 4,500 (a 40% discount). But watch out, this offer will only be available for a [b]limited time![/b] After [b]October 22,[/b] both Shugen Flayer (Ripper armor) skins will be sold separately in the Shop for [b]1,500 gems[/b] each, and the [u]Ripper[/u] universe cosmetic effects will disappear for an undetermined period…

 

[b]Don't miss out on this opportunity to proudly wear Ripper armor on your adventures… maybe even in search of a new Eden?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/918dfacbed30fdd89e55553f03b3fc5df39a222e.png[/img]

After a cataclysm of unprecedented magnitude, the air has become unbreathable and hostile creatures have taken over the planet. The last survivors have been forced to shelter as best they can in a tower. Among them, a group of volunteers are being trained to seek out a new garden of Eden. They're known as "Rippers"! While out on a reconnaissance mission, Oak's squad meets Junk, a young optimist who does not seem to have been affected by the state of the planet…

 
[h3][u]About the Author[/u][/h3]
Jeronimo Cejudo came in second in the Jump Tezuka Manga Contest (international section), whose jury included Akira Toriyama ([u]Dragon Ball[/u], [u]Dr Slump[/u]), Eiichirō Oda ([u]One Piece[/u]), Takehiko Inoue ([u]Slam Dunk[/u], [u]Vagabond[/u]) and even Kōhei Horikoshi ([u]My Hero Academia[/u]) – a first for a French author!

notes.title: Chafers are invading the World of Twelve!
notes.notes:
Ominous clicks fill the air, and an oppressive, almost sinister, atmosphere looms… The Chafers are preparing to launch a new assault on the World of Twelve, and it's up to you to stop them! Until [b]October 22,[/b] a trio of brother knights has reunited to break some bones while the breaking is good. So to speak…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/026efc925bbffff9a503c53d54470910cccc6034.png[/img]

Some thought they were dead and gone, and they weren't all wrong. The Chafers took advantage of the rising waters to bolster their ranks with those who drowned in great numbers. Usually confined to their island, where misdeeds reign supreme, they are now convinced that their survival after the Great Wave depends on them annihilating all forms of life to draft new souls in their army. Three legendary heroes have returned to thwart their newest invasion plan and are battling it out in the [b]Time Portal…[/b]
One for all, and all against them![h2][u]Defeat Them All, Then Defeat Even More…[/u][/h2]
 

[b]Can you smell the sweet scent of petrichor? Make no mistake – it might be the last whisper of nature that you ever remember.[/b]

 

[b]Play as the three brother knights[/b] – Oblero, Ferrero and Baron Romero – in a battle where death is no longer the goal and the loot depends on how many [b]Chafers you annihilate.[/b]

 

[b]Tireless and deadly, Chafers rise again and again, with no end in sight. Yet, there must be a way to stop them…[/b]

 

It'll take [b]five turns[/b] to finish them off, and their corpses won't go down easily – they'll become more and more powerful and threatening as you eliminate them.

 

[b]Relentless Waves[/b]

 

Use [b]each knight's special ability[/b] strategically and don't let yourself be overwhelmed by the crashing waves of enemies or the two bosses that will take turns trying force you into submission!

 

[b]Will you end up joining them?[/b]

 
[h2][u]Get Treasures with the New Battle Pass[/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/56a48bfb3c676e720304c33904a1233b8ba61e09.jpg[/img]

New recruit upon new recruit, the Chafers have amassed an impressive collection of cosmetic items. With the [b]Platinum Pass,[/b] you'll unlock [b]more than fifty-six treasures:[/b] an [b]Oscar runt pet,[/b] a [b]Chafer Skull headgear,[/b] and even a [b]putrid aura…[/b] They're available now in the [b]in-game shop,[/b] so make no bones about it: get them before they're six feet under again!

 
For some, death is just a phase, while for others it's an art…

notes.title: Ankama Convention: WAVEN Livestream Recap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/918d97de30aba04ed82621677031a33772a17035.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]WAVEN - Mobile Early Access[/u][/h2]
One of the high points of 2024 was the global launch of the mobile app. On July 2, the Google Play and App Store platforms welcomed the latest episode in the Krosmoz trilogy: [b][u]WAVEN[/u]![/b] With that major milestone behind us, we can now focus on the future, with version 1.0 in our crosshairs.

 

We have already announced that we no longer want to link the availability of the mobile version to that of version 1.0 of the game. Why? Quite simply because we still have a long way to go to get there. Several features and improvements are already in the works. We're using this early access to continue our work and new content while addressing existing aspects of the game that require our attention.

 

One recent and significant example is that we have been forced to update the entire game engine (Unity) following an announcement by Android to developers. The Mountain View company strongly recommended using a more recent version of Unity or risk having all future updates of the application be blocked. This requirement explains, in large part, why versions 0.19 and the upcoming 0.20 offer limited content. Our technical team has been focusing its efforts on this port. It is a colossal undertaking, one that is invisible to players and yet absolutely necessary.

 

Now, back to the main subject. The mobile release received a warm welcome. You've probably noticed increased community activity, either directly in the game or on discussion and mutual help platforms. Your engagement has been palpable and it makes us very proud. Thank you very much, all of you!

 
[h2][u]What's Next?[/u][/h2]
 
[h3]Upcoming Seasons[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/eebe541b487c89c3d3a7d4b591093133e8dbfe8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/b1c906d29d238b44eac093818e63b8ab74b9917f.png[/img]

The Trool Fair has barely set up in [b][u]WAVEN[/u][/b] and we're already talking about the next adventures waiting for you in the Time Portal. Starting on September 24, play as the three members of the Brother Knights: Oblero, Ferrero and Baron Romero. The Chafers have discovered a way to invade the World of Twelve, and it's up to you to stop them from bringing their sinister, terrifying, deadly plans to fruition!

 

Then, starting October 22, the Vampyres will be causing havoc. Escape from the hold of the Vampyre World-Boat and send Ghouls and Vampyres scuttling back to their coffins. Wake up these blood suckers, poison their favorite beverage, and neutralize them once and for all!

 
[h2][u]And the Bulk of the Content?[/u][/h2]
You know us well enough to know that Ankama is cursed to not keep its promises when it comes to release dates (it's a curse or a nasty habit depending on your point of view). For that reason, the content we're going to announce won't have any precise dates.
 
[h3]Progression[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/493046798fba246016d2dfa969c69fe208e2836e.png[/img]

Reworking progression isn't a feature as such, but an iterative underlying process that can spread over several updates. Rest assured, we don't intend to start over from scratch with the tutorial (not this time) because, overall, it fulfils its role well as the data we collect from new players shows. However, certain explanations and tooltips could be adjusted to make it easier for beginners to immediately understand the mechanic being presented the first time they read them.

 

This work improving legibility will also extend to descriptions of items, their effects, combinations, and characters, which will have an impact on the overall balance of the game. Our goal is to make [b][u]WAVEN[/u][/b] less frustrating to understand when it comes to theory crafting and building while also preserving the depth and identity of its elements. These reflections will apply to both the difficulty curve and overall progression.
 
[h3]Sacrier and Osamodas[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6a6ca07ef2e5a06931297223bc5e2418f8a9fe5a.png[/img]

Every day, we get an impressive amount of questions on the release of these two gods and their heroes. We know just how much travelers in the Krosmoz love the Sacrier and Osamodas classes, whether it's in [b][u]DOFUS[/u],[/b] [b][u]WAKFU[/u],[/b] or [b][u]WAVEN[/u].[/b] We're just as impatient to add them to the roster as you are to play them.

 

However, we've decided to delay their arrival until we've made solid progress on the game's progression and balancing (see above). We want to be certain that adding these new deities is done as smartly and smoothly as possible without compromising quality, the meta, or the gameplay experience.

 

We know that this delay may be disappointing but the decision is motivated by your determination to offer content that meets your expectations and we want to take as much time as needed rather than risk rushing the release.
 
[h3]Echoes of Past Seasons[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/0c31892ce2f3671a226b08bbb89f17e473ebb73c.png[/img]

As early as the first monster seasons, you had told us that you would like to see the season fights stay in the game. It would be a shame to deprive new castaways of fun and original content or prevent veteran players from going back to their favorite fights. We have not yet decided exactly what form that would take. Will there be rewards? Will we make these former fights competitive with a ladder? We're still thinking about these questions and more.
 
[h3]Guilds[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/57307bf7ca9afa87cbf371002b1ffea843c48364.png[/img]

This social feature, highly anticipated by the community, could very well be the content that will be added to the game first. Like they can in [b][u]DOFUS[/u][/b] and [b][u]WAKFU[/u],[/b] castaways in [b][u]WAVEN[/u][/b] will be able to band together in guilds for different activities, to unlock bonuses, or just chat with each other. The headquarters (HQ) of each guild will be a customizable hub from which they can set out on cooperative missions with their members or to face off against other guilds. It's the perfect opportunity to introduce two new competitive and seasonal game modes.
 
[h3]Boss Fights[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a0146faa9c6488f62166735bd13e72eb0c7034f9.png[/img]

Some of you might already know these under another name (Q4), but this game mode will be unique because it will be the first to offer content for four players. Some of you had the opportunity to test an early version during previous conventions, and we've already talked about this game mode in a livestream Q&A where it had already caught our attention… In our minds, we want to revitalize the PvPvE aspect of [b][u]WAVEN[/u][/b] by adding a pinch of exoticism inspired by roguelite mechanics. Four castaways will face off in a challenge in which only the best will survive. Start the session with a bag of kamas to distribute in your deck, face successive waves of monsters, summon allies to your territory that become enemies on your opponents' territories, and use rest turns to spend the kamas you earn at a kiosk to adjust your deck based on events on your board. Special waves will put your strategy to the test, and only the best will take home the win.
 
[h3]Story Mode – Book II: Chapter 1[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/03c516fcd358c11a42c7b3a228da57048534ae7e.png[/img]

Book I has been available in the game for more than one year now. During that time, players have been able to investigate the mysterious rift that appeared in Astrub from which Shushus are trying to invade the World of Twelve. While Evangelyne tried to uncover the secret of the floating entity in the middle of the island, you accompanied Percedal and Pin into the island's underground tunnels where a Shushu labyrinth had formed. During this adventure, you had to face off against the goddess Cra herself, under the thrall of the Shushus. Despite your efforts, she was carried off by an enigmatic demon. All efforts to save her failed. Your goal is now clear – you must protect the gods!

 

In Book II, you'll try to untangle a new intrigue, accompanied by Evangelyne and other… surprising… characters. As your investigation progresses, you'll find yourself involved in troubling business in the middle of the island nation of Brakmar. What horrible secret will you uncover this time? Just how far has the Shushu threat spread? And above all, will you be able to save the gods? Only time will tell.
 
[h3]Asynchronous Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a9b2d634fd638d50cd0e8dd0aeff9c48c4204c1b.png[/img]

This game mode is one of the pillars of [b][u]WAVEN[/u].[/b] We already discussed this last year. We intend to completely overhaul this facet of the game, which you were able to test in an old Alpha. We would like to keep the minions – those monsters you could recruit to your crew throughout your adventures on the monster islands – and their role while putting more of a focus on ships, which are currently purely cosmetic. Why not send your crew to sail the seas of the World of Twelve and explore uncharted territories? Maybe they'll come back with valuable resources, or perhaps they'll sink under the attack of another pirate ship? One thing is certain: We want to develop a new gameplay loop that is solid and has depth as part of an asynchronous mode.
 
[h3]Island Nations and Dungeon Detour Zones[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/2d1466b21bc42aa212e0b24c33ed0de54f3bfdb3.png[/img]

We are aware that the island nations are not some of our castaways' favorite zones, and for good reason. All the same, the challenges offered there are both original and fun to overcome. The problem lies mainly in the lack of peddlers. When a coveted item shows up in an island nation's rotating loot, players often don't bother to farm it. In the best case, they may turn to another goal but often they end up dropping out. This isn't the type of experience that we want to encourage because we know just how frustrating the situation can be. This is why we're thinking about ways we can improve the island nations and dungeon detour zones, which are equally neglected.

 
[h3]Final Words[/h3]
The entire [b][u]WAVEN[/u][/b] team hopes that this overview of our next (major) projects has reassured about the trust you've given us. Your support and feedback are essential to us, and we are extremely impatient to roll out these next stages of our adventure together with you. We are determined to offer a satisfying experience and continue to expand our universe with the same passion that has driven our team from the start. Once again, thank you!

The WAVEN Team

notes.title: The Trool Fair has opened in WAVEN!
notes.notes:
The sweet smell of cotton candy (or cotton candeh as the locals say) is filling the World of Twelve… Mysterious caravans of carnies worked tirelessly through the night to build strange structures in the Time Portal. The Trool Fair has come to WAVEN until [b]September 24th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a07bbdc4cabd91847008f63819d0de12cd580a69.jpg[/img]

Do you see that huge Ferris wheel over there? It's almost as high as the Great Wave was! From here, you can even hear the screams of joy and fear from kids and adults alike. (Some people never outgrow their fear of heights.) The Time Portal has become a joyous spectacle of lights, floating balloons and upbeat music. It's become the hottest destination of the season…

 
[b]The iconic Trool Fair is FINALLY here![/b]
 

 
[h2][u]Activities for (Almost) Every Adventurer[/u][/h2]
 
[b]Come closer, come closer, have no fear!
The fair is free with just one Season Ticket!
 [/b]
 

Join in the [b]fun[/b] with the new season fight and win prizes. The carnies have prepared [b]three minigames[/b] to test you. Rack up as many points as you can in a row in each challenge to make it into the [b]season rankings[/b] and earn [b]extra rewards![/b]

 
[h3]Tofu Tap[/h3]
Hold onto your hammer and smash as many tofus as possible! The more you hit, the more come back – it defies all logic… Hit the Rock to unlock a [b]Huge Hammer Blow[/b] and carry out a devastating attack to maximize your points and generate even more blows!

 

[b]Watch out for your fingers while the timer is running…[/b]

 
[h3]Three-Cage Monte (No Cheating, Promise)![/h3]
Think no carnie could ever trick you? Prove it! Try to find the prisoner hidden in one of several covered cages. If you pick the right cage, the game'll get harder with even more cages. The carnies will give you [b]eight tries[/b] before the next activity begins!

 

[b]No tricks, promise![/b]

 
[h3]Bomb Squad![/h3]
Various rocks and precious stones are scattered randomly on the field. The carnies will lend you seven bombs: two small, two medium and two large. Place them wisely on the board to [b]trigger explosions[/b] and create chain reactions, targeting the precious stones in priority! If you break a rock enough times, a precious stone might just appear…

 

[b]What are you waiting for? Come join in the fun! Play all three minigames and try to win the jackpot in this new WAVEN season![/b]

 
[h2][u]Get Your Souvenirs in the New Battle Pass[/u][/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/c8ae53f1efd7a99a8f6e313221e7274cea3218e5.png[/img]

Before you leave to go adventuring, swing by the souvenir shop! No less than [b]56 rewards[/b] are waiting eagerly for you: a [b]Kwaker[/b] pet (a real one!), a [b]souvenir balloon,[/b] and even [b]festive pennants…[/b] Get your fill of confetti in the [b]Gold Pass[/b] and [b]Platinum Pass[/b] available now in WAVEN's [b]in-game shop![/b]

notes.title: Ultimate Skins – Hoghji Hamamoto
notes.notes:
From [b]August 26 until September 24 at 10:00 a.m. (CEST),[/b] a fresh breeze will be blowing across the World of Twelve with new designs inspired by tradition available in the [b]in-game Shop[/b] – just perfect for the stylish hero that lives in us all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f9a1a2815f22dfd159b7f3737e694d084a4a12ac.jpg[/img]

Refined. That just might be the first word that comes to mind when you first see these new outfits that flutter gracefully in the wind* throughout the island nations, inspired by the rich history of Pig Island. Where cherry trees flower and cannon mist caresses nearly impenetrable walls, Hoghji Hamamoto – eminent fashion icon on Pig Island – has revealed his poetic collection to the World of Twelve, a collection that tells of courage and honor in a culture of success marked by the end of a frankly dubious practice…

[i]*Understandable… or not.[/i]

[b]Like Niels Laren, go incognito among the Pigs with these Ultimate Skins![/b]

 
[h2]Pikuxala Hand*[/h2]
[i]Pikuxala roars,
Under the emerald moon,
Xelor's proud heart beats.[/i]

[h2]Orishi Shears*[/h2]
[i]Scarlet armor shines,
Orishi shears through the storm,
Under steel-gray skies.[/i]

[h2]Shaden Shiru*[/h2]
[i]In the blue mist's glow,
Shiru dances with brilliance,
Fire and silk ablaze.[/i]

[h2]Stalaktoss Glaive*[/h2]
[i]Iop stands among us,
Blade of wind and drifting clouds,
Clueless in the storm.[/i]

[h2]Apostruker Scalpel*[/h2]
[i]Apostruker stands,
Bamboo forged in wild rage,
Beneath peaceful skies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/1daf587e215c973d3d7c699439270ebf2afcdea3.png[/img]

Each Ultimate Skin is available for [b]1,200 gems for a limited time,[/b] after which they will all be available for individual purchase for 1,500 gems.

[b]Don't miss this chance to give your hero an elegant allure! Check out the new outfits by Hoghji Hamamoto now in the in-game Shop! And if they're a hit for the ages, other outfits by the famous designer could be unveiled…[/b]

notes.title: WAVEN Livestream – Q&A #3 | Answers
notes.notes:
On [b]Friday, June 28,[/b] we invited you to a livestream dedicated to questions from the community. See our answers to your questions now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/d3279127db3dab1ed56b4d2594d69d2acb26be42.png[/img]

Many of you submitted your questions, and even more voted for them! We collected the most popular questions in each WAVEN community. You'll find the answers below.

 
[h2][u]YOUR QUESTIONS AND OUR ANSWERS[/u][/h2]
 

[b][u]1. Will there be an option that lets us reorganize our characters in the character select interface?[/u][/b]

 

This is a good idea for making the game more user-friendly, but we don't know when it can be integrated.

 

[b][u]2. How do you plan to resolve the issue of animations taking too long in combat?[/u][/b]

 

We're aware of the issues with animations; certain visual effects and animations have been significantly sped up to make combat more dynamic. As we consider things, we always bear this in mind when new animations and effects are created. For example, the hero Apostruker Scalpel recently underwent a full revamp, with animations redesigned to speed up the hero's turns. We also know that certain quests, such as the Brakmar Forge, need special attention to streamline their mechanics by reducing animation times.

 

We can parallelize certain actions, e.g. two effects running at the same time, and we'll do this more and more. However, many effects in WAVEN follow a complex causal sequence, which makes it hard to speed up certain animations without affecting the intelligibility of effects on the screen.

 

[b][u]3. Will you be adding Necromic and Albueran items to the end-of-dungeon peddlers? [/u][/b]

 

Yes, we will, as this was an oversight on our part. All the Necromic and Albueran items have been added to chests and the rotating loot after the change to Krosmic Mode – Necros. Logically, these items should also be offered by the peddlers.

 

[b][u]4. Are you planning to overhaul the lore and context for WAVEN?[/u][/b]

 

Certain aspects will be addressed throughout the main quest, and you'll gradually understand all the stakes in WAVEN. We've also said we want to have a bestiary, which could include context elements, like the various Pig Island clans.

 

[b][u]5. Will Krosmic Mode – Sacriers exclusively require you to play as a Sacrier?[/u][/b]

 

This is an option we're considering. We haven't set the rules for this edition yet.

 

[b]Question from the chat: do you think you'll make transfers free for the next Krosmic Mode?[/b]

 

We've collected data from the first Krosmic Mode, which we'll be using to set the rules for the next one. We have to account for technical and design constraints, as well as player feedback. We haven't established whether or not transfers will be paid, or in what currency it would be.

 

[b][u]6. Will the mobile version have more options when it comes out?[/u][/b]

 

The PC and mobile versions are identical; only the interfaces will vary to fit the corresponding platform. If any usability aspects are detrimental to one or the other, we'll look for a solution.

Recall that WAVEN is a cross-save, cross-play, and cross-platform game; you play on the same account, with the same progression, and on the same game servers across the board.

 

[b]Message from the chat: some have already been using the mobile app for months now…[/b]

 

That's right; we did a soft launch in certain countries. This allowed us to test the application on a large scale and to collect performance data to improve it. We know that some players in excluded countries have been able to get the app through the back door. We strongly discourage the downloading of applications from unofficial platforms, as the integrity of the files cannot be guaranteed, and account security may be compromised.

 

[b]Question from the chat: do you need an internet connection to play on mobile?[/b]

 

In order to play WAVEN, whether on PC/Mac or mobile/tablet, an internet connection is required. There is no offline mode.

 

[b][u]7. Are you going to buff heroes that are weak in the meta instead of nerfing ones that are strong?[/u][/b]

 

We tend to improve weaker heroes rather than weaken strong ones, as demonstrated by the recently revamped Pikuxala or the Apostruker Scalpel. This is a dynamic we want to preserve for future balancing updates. However, we can't leave certain overpowered ("auto-winning") combinations of heroes untouched.

 

Some comments suggest that all heroes should be abnormally powerful. We think if all heroes are too strong, none of them truly are. Also, we distinguish between a character's power and the enjoyment they can provide: completing a fight in three seconds isn't a scenario we would consider fun or appealing for WAVEN. Making it too easy for heroes to do all the content would remove the tactical and strategic element of the game.

 

[b][u]8. What distribution of mobile and PC players do you expect for the official release?[/u][/b]

 

This estimate is exclusively internal.

 

[b][u]9. Are you planning a major update for the game's first anniversary?[/u][/b]

 

No, there won't be a major update for August 16TH, 2024. With WAVEN still being in early access, we'll reexamine this once the game is in version 1.0.

 

[b]Question from the chat: do you have an initiative system planned for multiplayer?[/b]

As mentioned in the last episode, the cooperative side of the game is under consideration, and that is something we have to look at.

 

[b][u]10. Will the next Krosmic Mode also go for 2 months? Will our progress be reset?[/u][/b]

 

The length and rules of the next Krosmic Mode will be based on what we aim to do and the content we'd like to offer. As for resetting progress, this is yet to be determined; we could see having a Krosmic Mode where we would import the data from Classic Mode…

 

[b][u]11. Do you plan to up the maximum level for characters?[/u][/b]

 

At this point, we're not planning to change max level for characters or items. If we do revisit this proposal, it would also feature a new progress curve that is of genuine interest.

 

[b][u]12. Will all the new content be added to Krosmic Mode first? Like Sacriers, Osamodas, etc.[/u][/b]

 

As previously noted, we will only offer Krosmic Modes if they are of interest. Not all of the new content will automatically be offered in early access with a Krosmic Mode. We've said that we intend to offer the Sacrier class in a special Krosmic Mode. For the Osamodas, we're still considering it.

 

[b][u]Question from the chat: will there be new Sacrier spells or items in the Sacrier Krosmic Mode?[/u][/b]

 

We won't reveal anything yet.

 

[b][u]Question from the chat: when will the next Krosmic Mode be released?[/u][/b]

 

We still won't reveal anything yet.

 

[b][u]Question from the chat: will dungeons' difficulty level be increased?[/u][/b]

 

There are no current plans to do so, but we might consider it.

 

[b][u]13. What changes have you made to the mobile version that caused it to be delayed?[/u][/b]

 

Since the delay of the mobile release was announced, we have reworked some of the onboarding content for new players (tutorial, character creation, Astrub, new conditions for unlocking menus), plus the daily gifts and certain interfaces. We are still applying player feedback to make the game more user-friendly. We have added new expansions (Albuera, Necroworld) and new game modes (Time Portal). We think the WAVEN application is at a good level of quality to be opened up to the general public, and we're continuing to work on it with each update. We hope that all players who download it will be happy with it!

 

[b][u]Question from the chat: will you be keeping the Apostruker Scalpel as a healer in the simplified character creation view?[/u][/b]

 

We are aware that the description of the heroes shown could use some changes.

 

[b][u]14. Are you going to make Paladir builds more varied? They are too focused on ATTACK.[/u][/b]

 

We don't agree with that assessment. The results of the survey at the end of Krosmic Mode – Necros indicate the opposite. When designing the Paladir heroes, we made sure each one could get something out of different play styles. Certain heroes get more out of certain archetypes (ATTACK, MAGIC, COMPANIONS) than others, and we'll continue rebalancing them.

 

[b][u]15. Why are most of the island nation quests only doable SOLO?[/u][/b]

 

The majority of quests on the island nations can be done in co-op. Only three quests in Bonta, one in Brakmar, and one in Amakna can only be done solo. For the main quest, technical and gameplay constraints require it to be completed in single-player. We want everyone to do the main quest at their own pace, while the co-op side is rewarded in other game modes to gain XP, farm for equipment, and so on.

 
[h2][u](BONUS) MORE QUESTIONS FROM CHAT[/u][/h2]
 

[b][u]16. Do you have a guild system planned?[/u][/b]

 

Yes, this system is still slated for 2024.

 

[b][u]17. Are you planning to redesign the 20-point Ether spells?[/u][/b]

 

We know these spells aren't very popular because their effects are reset with each use. This change was needed to prevent overuse, but we're aware they have lost value, and we're going to explore how to them more appealing.

 

[b][u]18. How many heroes will the Sacrier class get?[/u][/b]

 

We're currently planning on five heroes for the Sacrier class.

 

[b][u]19. How do you plan to make the class-specific elemental spells, which are currently dominated by the Necromic and Albueran spells, more appealing?[/u][/b]

 

We recognize that the Necromic and Albueran spells are powerful. Our goal is to make them more situational, whereas elemental spells should be the primary choice in decks. We're rebalancing things to achieve this goal.

 

[b][u]20. Why space out the release of new heroes and classes so much?[/u][/b]

 

As stated in a previous episode, the creation of new heroes and classes takes a lot of time and resources. This includes creating visuals, designing and balancing spells, along with animation and sound design. Each new piece of content requires choices in terms of allocating resources and prioritizing.

 

[b][u]20. Part 2 - Aren't there already Sacrier heroes, though?[/u][/b]

 

There are, but they need an extensive overhaul to perfectly integrate with the game in its current state.

 

[b][u]21. Are you going to improve housing?[/u][/b]

 

Housing is something we'd like to develop more, but there are no immediate plans to do so.

 

[b][u]22. Is there a chance that Sacrier heroes' appearance will change?[/u][/b]

 

No, the Sacrier heroes as they appeared in the latest alpha are the final versions.

 

[b][u]23. Are you planning to add hero skins to the shop?[/u][/b]

 

Yes, we'll be offering more skins for heroes, as well as world and combat effects, to add variety to the customization options.

 

[b][u]24. Still no Eliatropes/Eliotropes/Ecaflips on the agenda?[/u][/b]

 

No, we're focusing on the Sacrier and Osamodas heroes first before we consider other classes.

 

[b][u]25. How are you coming along with co-op, haven islands, the asynchronous arena?[/u][/b]

 

All three of those are things we'd like to work on, but we don't have anything to share about them for now.

 

[b][u]26. Do you have anything planned for PvP?[/u][/b]

 

We're still working on balancing, and we recognize the interest in potential improvements, but this isn't a priority for us this year.

 

[b][u]27. Will there be a global recruitment or general chat?[/u][/b]

 

No, but we'd like to enhance social features and multiplayer/co-op.

 

[b][u]27. Part 2 - Will there be guild chat?[/u][/b]

 

Very likely, yes.

 

[b][u]28. Could you add game modes for max-level characters only?[/u][/b]

 

We recognize that the current late game could be expanded and developed. We're gradually adding content for high-level characters, like Albuera and the Necroworld with the fight against Toross Mordal. We are actively discussing the late game, and we have things planned for players.

 

[b][u]29. What is your vision for co-op?[/u][/b]

 

We want to make the game as enjoyable in co-op as it is in single-player. WAVEN is a multiplayer game that allows for adventuring with friends, and we'd like to reinforce that aspect.

 

[b][u]30. Do you plan to add new "families" of companions, like the Brotherhood of the Tofu?[/u][/b]

 

In our latest expansions, Albuera and Necroworld, we added thematic effects that reinforce the characters' identity. If other expansions allow for the introduction of new "families" with specific effects, we'll consider them.

 

[b][u]31. Is the game more geared toward PvP or PvE?[/u][/b]

 

We give attention to both of these modes. PvE enjoys broader content, but we're still working to balance PvP and we recognize the need for improvement.

 

[b][u]32. Are you still planning to release Q3 and Q4?[/u][/b]

 

[i]Q3 is the "boss fight" system, and Q4 is the "boss fight with waves of monsters". [/u]These modes are still under consideration, but they're not planned yet.

 

[b][u]33. Are you going to roll out certain season fights again for anyone who missed them?[/u][/b]

 

Yes, we plan to do that.

 

[b][u]34. Do you intend to moderate inappropriate nicknames seen in the game?[/u][/b]

 

Currently, an automated moderation system is in effect. It is imperfect and sometimes requires human moderation. We're planning to gradually improve it.

 

[b][u]35. Will Necro spells still be available from Miranda?[/u][/b]

 

At this point we have no plans to remove them.

 

[b][u]36. Are you going to add an in-combat damage preview like in DOFUS?[/u][/b]

 

No, that's not on the agenda.

 

[b][u]37. What is the difference between HEALTH STEAL and DRAIN?[/u][/b]

 

DRAIN is a percentage of a hero's ATTACK converted into HEAL, whereas HEALTH STEAL converts the damage inflicted by a spell into HEAL. We are aware this distinction can be confusing.

 

[b][u]38. Will it be possible to enhance companions' survivability, particularly for high-level combat?[/u][/b]

 

If a build is geared toward companions, they shouldn't have any issues with survivability. However, certain companions need to be rebalanced.

 

[b][u]39. Do you plan to change pushback spells, such as allowing me to choose if I want a 1- or 2-cell pushback?[/u][/b]

 

Pushback spells are varied; some let you choose the number of cells, others do not. This is a game design choice.

 
[h2][u]STREAMING[/u][/h2]If you want to [b]watch the livestream again[/b] (in French with English subtitles):
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2183915053?filter=all&sort=time]TWITCH REPLAY[/url]

See you soon in the next session,
The WAVEN Team

[h1]Taurdown at the Market[/h1]

Mandhal, the leader of the Taurs, has a bone to pick with Amakna – the new and questionable farming methods being used by the inhabitants of the island nation are making the Taurs sick, much to the displeasure of their leader!

Alas, one of your former companions, Gladiataur, has eaten some (very) suspicious fruit and can't stop himself from devouring more… He'll do everything he can to stop you in your tracks. It's time to make him see reason in this new season fight!

notes.title: God Iop Kit: Flex Your Muscles!
notes.notes:
From [b]July 16 to 30 at 10 a.m. (CEST),[/b] unleash your full power (or at least do a good job pretending) with the [b]God Iop Kit![/b] The [b]WAVEN Shop's weekly rotation[/b] is calling to the most courageous among you. Proud Iops, this is your time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/bdd4bd2db71c4a43c3c69bf37c4eac9278400d54.jpg[/img]

Their names (and hollow heads) resound throughout the World of Twelve whenever courage, bravery and power are sought. Iops embody the essence of the true warrior, always ready to charge head-first into a fight or face off against the toughest dungeon keepers. Easily recognized by their snappy attire, bulging biceps, and huge swords, they've got a pesky tendency to hit first and ask questions later… or maybe just hit some more!

notes.title: WAVEN – Mobile Application: Download It Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/78179552c75e3df93ed0e0cb7fe4de913027ea4b.png[/img]

[b]What a long and much-anticipated journey it was to get here![/b]

 

Initially, we planned to cast off at the end of 2023, but we weren't quite happy with the quality of the mobile experience. So we decided to postpone the launch until 2024… and now here we are! [b]FINALLY![/b]

 

We are extremely pleased and proud to be able to offer [b]this application in early access[/b] to all our smartphone and tablet players. As something that many people were clamoring for (and rightly so), this mobile release represents a [b]major milestone[/b] in WAVEN's development (which is still in early access). We'd very much like to thank you for your patience and help throughout the fine-tuning process.

 

[b]The mobile world welcomes WAVEN with open arms![/b]

 

Every minute of your daily life becomes an opportunity for adventure; whether you're on public transport, sitting in a waiting room, or comfortably seated on your sofa, you can now take the World of Twelve with you wherever you go.

 
[h2][u]Constant Progress Wherever You Are![/u][/h2]
It's possible because the game is cross-platform with cross-save ability. Your odyssey, your hero, your companions, and everything you collect as you progress will be [b]seamlessly synchronized*[/b] [b]across platforms[/b].

 

* [u]An internet connection is required to play WAVEN.[/u]
[h2][u]Join the Global Castaway Community![/u][/h2]
WAVEN is also a cross-play experience, meaning [b]you're playing on the same servers as all the other players[/b] logged in from any platform. We believe in inclusivity between communities, and that it's important to break down the barriers that separate us from each other. And what unites all of us, after all, is farming! [b]The application is carefully optimized to guarantee a satisfying experience and stable performance,[/b] whether you're on PC or Mac, smartphone or tablet.

 

[b]What are you waiting for? Hurry up and join the adventure![/b]

 
[h2][u]The Internet Is Celebrating![/u][/h2]
We couldn't announce the mobile release without a little extra flourish! [b]If you log in to the game before 11:59 p.m. (Paris time) on July 31, you'll receive an exclusive emote:[/b] "Ruel" ([u]Hide the Pain[/u], for those in the know).

 

[b]Invade the WAVEN archipelagos now and emote away![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/a392ce3921047cdcdb59649e2e0d095b0aa89b15.jpg[/img]
 
[h2][u]Still in Early Access[/u][/h2]
[b]WAVEN is still in[/b] [b]"early access".[/b] While the mobile release marks a turning point in the game's development, that doesn't mean we've reached the official version 1.0 release of WAVEN yet. [b]We still have several more features and improvements planned before WAVEN can be ready for the open seas.[/b] This early access phase means we can continue our production and tackle all the aspects of the game that need our attention. Believe us, your feedback is always a great help in informing our choices.

 

[b]We'll be back shortly with a mid-way review. Stay tuned![/b]

 
[h2][u]Our Sincere Thanks[/u][/h2]
First of all, we'd like to express our deepest gratitude to the entire community that has followed and supported us since the beginning of this wonderful project, as well as to all those who joined us along the way. Remember, since setting sail from DOFUS Cube to WAKFU Heroes, we're now entering the waters of WAVEN mobile with some superb transmedia projects based around our universe. It's amazing! Our sincere thanks go to all the teams who have worked tirelessly to make this mobile port possible, and above all apply their talents to this wonderful story day after day. It's thanks to their dedication and passion that we're able to offer you such a unique and magical experience. At Ankama, we're super proud to be celebrating this collective success with you, all of us together.

 

[b]So…[/b]

[b]MERCI, THANK YOU, ¡GRACIAS!, OBRIGADO, DANKE SCHÖN!…[/b]

 
[h2][u]The World of Twelve Is Waiting for You![/u][/h2]
[b]Download the WAVEN app now[/b] and embark on new adventures! Together, let's continue to make history, explore new horizons and conquer the World of Twelve – even from the comfort of our couches!

notes.title: WAVEN – Mobile App: Coming July 2nd!
notes.notes:
WAVEN has been in early access on PC and Mac since August 16th, 2023, on the Ankama Launcher and Steam. The mobile app, for its part, has been in a [u]"soft launch"[/u] phase in limited countries and will ([b]finally![/b]) be opening to the whole world on July 2nd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/7e4dbcf03522f7c35961b74a26c4023eb4a648c3.png[/img]

[h2][u]The Shipwrecked Community Is Growing[/u][/h2]
WAVEN is coming to your smartphones and tablets on July 2nd!

After several months of tests, we've decided to extend WAVEN's early access to mobile devices, making the game available on mobile officially in all countries of the world!

The game will be [b]the same on all platforms[/b], and we'll keep adding more content and features with each version, building up to the big launch of WAVEN 1.0.

[h2][u]The Ultimate Cross-Platform and Cross-Save RPG Experience[/u][/h2]
Our goal is to let you play wherever you want, whenever you want, sailing between desktops, laptops and mobile devices with ease with a single account. All you need to do is log in to the WAVEN mobile app with your Ankama account to enjoy the full cross-platform experience.

You'll be able to start your adventure on one platform, continue it on another, and save all your progress on both, whether you're advancing the main quest, farming dungeons on Pig Island, or climbing the ranks in the season fights! [u]Cross-save[/u] is great, and cross-save at your fingertips is even better!

[h3][b]See you in your favorite app store on [u]July 2nd[/u]![/b][/h3]
