notes.title: WAVEN Livestream – Q&A #2 | Answers
notes.notes:
On [b]Tuesday, April 30th[/b], we invited you to a livestream dedicated to questions from the community. See our answers to your questions now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/93d6c8f2a882b7179659e0c1113f7710a6ca22d8.png[/img]
 

Many of you submitted your questions, and even more voted for them! We collected the most popular questions in each WAVEN community to answer which you'll find below.

 
[h2][u]Your Questions and Our Answers[/u][/h2]
 
[u][b][u]1. Why didn't you do the same you did for Astramantis Pike, with a direct early-access release of the hero in Classic Mode for a fee?[/u][/b][/u]

Krosmic Mode is a new game mode that allows us to freely redesign the player experience without impacting Classic Mode. For our first time running Krosmic Mode, we went with a common theme you see throughout the WAKFU series: the Necroworld. This was so we could develop an event based on this location and incorporate the Paladir heroes at the same time. When the Albuera expansion was released, we hadn't yet developed Krosmic Mode, but it was a theme we could have addressed in that game mode. Please note that we won't be rolling out a Krosmic Mode for all content expansions but will be picking and choosing events based on how much value they may add.

[u][b]2. Are you planning to revise the game's progression system, perhaps for something less farm-based?[/b][/u]

Currently, our game mechanics focus mainly on intensive farming to level up to 50 with equipment, characters and companions, and thus unlock the full potential of deckbuilding. However, once this threshold is reached, the only way to optimize is on a skills basis, which creates a glass ceiling for progression. And what do you do after that? We are aware that we need to think beyond this limitation, which would pave the way for a fresh, potentially more dynamic, boosted progression.

As for more collaborative progression, especially in terms of helping new players, one avenue we're exploring is the guild system. Newcomers could join a guild and get the benefit of equipment, and experience points and it would make it easier to form groups for combat, among other useful things. Please note that guilds are planned for 2024, as announced in our roadmap for this year. Further details will be announced shortly.

As for progress in Krosmic Mode, we should learn some helpful lessons from this initial version to help us plan for the next ones.

[b][u]3. What kind of players will you be focusing on in the future?[/u][/b]

WAVEN sets itself apart as a wonderful, promising and complex game. As the culmination of the DOFUS and WAKFU trilogy, it inherits exceptional depth from its illustrious predecessors. The challenge for WAVEN lies in standing out from its siblings while contributing its own unique essence. We attach great importance to the cross-platform aspect of the game. It offers a satisfying experience for players of all abilities, whether on mobile/tablet or PC. PC gamers generally devote multiple hours to their gaming sessions whereas mobile players tend to have more limited time available. We feel sure that the mobile version will expand our international audience more effectively than at present.

[u][b]Chat question: When will the mobile version be released?[/b][/u]

The mobile version is still slated for general release in 2024. We decided to postpone its release, initially announced for the end of 2023, so that we could continue our work on fine-tuning it. At the time, we weren't sufficiently satisfied with the quality of the application, but today we're almost there.

[u][b]Do you have any details you can share about Eliotrope heroes?[/b][/u]

For the moment, we have no plans for an Eliatrope or Eliotrope class. In our first Q&A livestream this year, we merely mentioned that we'd explored some gameplay through battles in the Time Portal where you could play as Yugo or Qilby, but a full-fledged class is not on the agenda. We already have the Sacrier class and its five heroes coming out this year, in 2024, then the Osamodas class will follow in 2025; it's only once these two classes are in game that we would have a chance to consider the possibility of integrating a new one.

[u][b]5. Can we expect Draconic heroes if Draconic spells are reintroduced?[/b][/u]

It's always a possibility. We explain the appearance of the Paladir heroes by the Necro invasion of the World of Twelve; this being the opportune moment to reintroduce Necromic spells and items. If the opportunity arises, we might consider reintroducing Draconic spells (which we'd have to rework) and, perhaps, heroes tied to this theme. That said, we haven't got this in the pipeline at the moment.

[u][b]6. Are you planning to increase XP gains for players with multiple alts?[/b][/u]

It's a possibility we haven't ruled out; we still need to gather more data about progression as a whole. We might, for example, consider a system similar to DOFUS, which has a sliding scale of bonuses based on the level difference between the highest character and the lower ones, or, for example, introduce a system specific to WAVEN, like something for each god.

[u][b]7. Are you planning to improve the game's co-op side?[/b][/u]

This is an ongoing project that some of our team are working on already. At the moment, we're aware that the cooperative and community aspects of the game need to be improved in a number of areas including combat with Elite monsters, initiative, companions with effects that may or may not be triggered by allied players, in-game chat, the group system, and so on. It's a big job that will see improvements with each new update. We're also already planning slight redesigns for certain heroes whose passives will encourage cooperation in combat, increasing the number of solo and group builds, as well as a new chat room.

[u][b]Chat question: Are you planning to include an initiative stat like with DOFUS and WAKFU, based on the build?[/b][/u]

This is something we're definitely looking into.

[u][b]8. Are there any plans to add alternative rewards to FTRs in future Krosmic Modes for quests that have already been completed?[/b][/u]

We already did an initial test with Miranda and Kabrok's store, where you can get helpful resources such as runes, kamas, and chests, and so on, in exchange for Wakfu fragments. We wanted to see how impactful such offers would be in game, and their price based on the amount available, and so on. Depending on the data we collect from the initial release of Krosmic Mode, we'll be able to decide whether or not to add these offers to Classic Mode. For the FTRs, we will analyze the Krosmic Mode data and adapt them as necessary.

[u][b]Chat question: How will we get Necromic spells if Miranda doesn't provide them in Classic Mode?[/b][/u]

This is obviously an issue we need to find a solution for. Items (equipment, companions) will be included in rotating loot.

[b][u]9. Are there any updates planned for Classic Mode when Krosmic Mode is underway?[/u][/b]

Content that was playable in early access will generally get added to Classic Mode after. All changes and fixes from any patches will apply to both game modes.

[u][b]Chat question: Could a balancing update be rolled out at the same time?[/b][/u]

Yes.

[u][b]10. What classes do you plan to release after Sacrier and Osamodas?[/b][/u]

We prefer to focus on the Sacrier and Osamodas classes before thinking about the next potential candidates.

[u][b]11. What are your plans for items that have already been maximized and that still drop in rewards?[/b][/u]

In our 2024 roadmap, we talked about Prestige Levels, which will enable you to infinitely increase your characters' progression without affecting their power. We'd like to focus on cosmetic items that will increase the customization element and show your progress beyond level 50. This system is still under development.

[u][b]12. When the Sacrier and Osamodas classes come out, will they have Paladir heroes?[/b][/u]

We aren't planning on that, but we aren't opposed to the idea. We could also introduce an "extraordinary" hero, like Astramantis Pike, when both classes are in game. But we're not going to promise anything as of yet.

[u][b]13. Will there be variations in companions (like a young Joris and an old Joris) who have different gameplay?[/b][/u]

For the time being, you only have variations in appearance for certain companions (Bull, Cadence), but we don't plan for them to have different gameplay.

[u][b]14. Will you be running seasonal events, such as an Al Howin event, with a dedicated island or specific objectives you have to get on certain monster islands?[/b][/u]

Yes, we want to, but it's not on the drawing board yet. Although, seasonal events do already exist in the Time Portal, depending on the current season.

[u][b]15. Are you going to be doing seasons based on the older series of the WAKFU series, like a fight between Percedal and Rubilax, for example?[/b][/u]

That's one avenue we could go down. Remember that, during KrosmoNote 2024, we told you all about Heroic Quests that would plunge players into a narrative and gameplay experience where they can relive events from every age of the Krosmoz. Perhaps a fight where you play Percedal who has to fight his Shushu Rubilax might be an idea…
 
[h2][u](BONUS) More Questions from Chat…[/u][/h2][h2][u][b]16. What have you got planned for the Haven Islands?[/b][/u][/h2]
There's a particular avenue we want to explore with the guilds that will be arriving soon…

[u][b]17. Are we getting any nation-themed cosmetics (Bonta, Brakmar, Amakna)?[/b][/u]

There are no plans for that at the moment, but it could be an interesting way to go.
[u][b]18. When will Book II of Story Mode arrive?[/b][/u]
The follow-up to Story Mode with Book II is scheduled for 2024. We don't have a date for you yet.

[u][b]19. Are you going to introduce larger islands for exploration?[/b][/u]

We've haven't planned on it, no, as we already think that exploring the island nations is relatively time-consuming. At the same time, we wanted to take this idea of getting "lost in exploring" further with the Necroworld, through its different rooms and districts. Remember that, in WAVEN, the majority of the World of Twelve is submerged by water, much more of it than in the WAKFU Era. Only a few islands and islets remain.

[u][b]20. Will the Krosmic Modes follow on from each other, or will there be a break between them?[/b][/u]

The Krosmic Modes will be separated from each other by a break of several months.

[u][b]21. Are you going to be introducing shortcuts back to players' boats?[/b][/u]

This shortcut used to exist before, but we decided to remove it. We want players to wander around the islands, creating movement and not disappearing in the middle to sail off to another destination.

[u][b]22. Do you plan to add any utility channels, such as a recruitment channel in the chat?[/b][/u]

That's one of the things we were considering for improving the community side of the game.

[u][b]23. When will the mobile version be available?[/b][/u]

The mobile version is still scheduled for 2024.

[u][b]24. Any news on PvX mode?[/b][/u]

Asynchronous Mode is still on the drawing board, but it's not our current priority.

[u][b]25. Could we be getting Frigost Island at some point?[/b][/u]

Perhaps a few destinations from the World of Twelve that we know from DOFUS and WAKFU could gradually see the light of day in WAVEN.

[u][b]26. You talked about a competitive ranking for Krosmic Mode. Is it going to happen any time soon?[/b][/u]

Yes, we just ran out of time to release it for this initial run of Krosmic Mode. You will be getting a competitive ranking for future Krosmic Modes.

[u][b]27. Do you plan to add new island nations, such as Sufokia, and more monster islands?[/b][/u]

There are no plans in the works for this right now because a monster island takes so much collaboration and work between all the game teams. It's not the kind of content we can put together quickly and easily. That said, if a transmedia event featuring a nation we haven't yet developed in WAVEN (such as Sufokia) gets rolled out at Ankama, perhaps we'll consider integrating it.

[u][b]28. Will we be able to replay old season fights, even without the rewards?[/b][/u]

We haven't got plans to do that as yet, but it's an idea we still like.

[u][b]29. Are you planning to add dungeons and merchants to the island nations?[/b][/u]

Monster island peddlers require island currency, which you can get by fighting on the island in question, as well as through daily quests. However, there are no daily quests on island nations. Historically, you could only get island currency through dailies, but it's now also available through fights. As a result, we decided not to include peddlers in the island nations. We might reconsider if there is strong demand from the community for this.

[u][b]30. Are there any plans for season fights that can be fought on both game modes, and which can take a lot of time if you want get all the Wakfu fragments?[/b][/u]

Our aim when we create season fights is to make sure they don't take long to complete and that they're in-depth enough for anybody who wants to try joining the rankings. Thanks to your feedback, we also know that season fights can quickly get tiresome when you have to use up tens of season tickets before the end of the current season; this is a problem we need to find a solution for.

[u][b]31. Are you planning to revamp the alternative routes for dungeons?[/b][/u]

There aren't any plans for that yet, but we know players can overlook them.

[u][b]32. Have you thought about doing any collaborations?[/b][/u]

We've already collaborated with some great artists and writers (Tony Valente, Gary Vanaka, Vincent Nghiem, to mention but a few) on skins, and more are on the way!

[u][b]33. Are you planning to share deck slots between Krosmic Mode and Classic Mode?[/b][/u]

We were thinking of this for future versions of Krosmic Mode; it's something we want to do very much.

[u][b]34. Is there a way for F2P players to get skins?[/b][/u]

It's currently possible to get 25 free gems a week from the battle pass; we changed the daily gifts that gave you gems from time to time.

[u][b]35. Will the cosmetics from old Battle Passes return to the store?[/b][/u]

This is something we could explore.

[u][b]36. Are you planning on any cooperative content for more than three players?[/b][/u]

No comment from the team…

[u][b]37. Do you plan to introduce more character slots?[/b][/u]

Currently, the number of character slots is unlimited. You should be able to see this on the character selection page.

[u][b]38. Are we going to get the option to change our characters' color?[/b][/u]

We're not planning a DOFUS or WAKFU-style system, but instead we're expanding our range of cosmetics and skins to provide more in-depth character customization. Lately, we've been rolling out Chromatic Skins, which are the basic hero skins with alternative colors, at a reduced price.

[u][b]39. Are you planning any content improvements for Krosmic Mode when it gets rolled out in Classic Mode?[/b][/u]

Based on your feedback, we'll be adjusting certain content (difficulty, progression speed, etc.). Once it arrives in Classic Mode, this content will be much smoother and more rewarding.

[u][b]40. What's your opinion on balancing attack decks compared with magic decks?[/b][/u]

We are aware that, the way things are balanced currently, magic decks are more appealing than others. Balancing is a core area that is getting iterated over all of our updates.

[u][b]41. Is there going to be a hero mode for playing multiple characters at the same time?[/b][/u]

No, we prefer players to help each other in cooperative content rather than playing on their own.

[u][b]42. Are we going to be able to use items from PvE in PvP?[/b][/u]

We made a deliberate decision not to have any equipment (rings, armbands) or skills transfer across to PvP.

[u][b]43. Will the maximum level always be 50?[/b][/u]

We haven't got any plans right now to change this level cap.

[u][b]44. Are you planning to revamp the challenges?[/b][/u]

We don't see any reason to, but perhaps we'll come up with some new challenges later.

[u][b]45. Will you be including boots or amulets in the equipment?[/b][/u]

We don't plan to, no. We don't want to add in new items if we don't see the benefit in terms of gameplay.

[u][b]46. Will there be any rare loot in the game (like DOFUS with Dofus eggs)?[/b][/u]

Maybe… Not for the time being though.

[u][b]47. How do I change my in-game nickname?[/b][/u]

This is not currently possible. Perhaps one day, we'll have a service allowing you to do just that.

[u][b]48. Is there going to be a crafting system at some point?[/b][/u]

No plans for that currently, no.

See you soon in the next session,

notes.title: Krosmic Mode – Necros: Transfer Your Progress!
notes.notes:
Time is ticking away: [b]Krosmic Mode – Necros[/b] is nearly over. Starting on [b]Tuesday, June 4th,[/b] you'll be able to transfer all your progress to Classic Mode in WAVEN. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/d78242b4460843a5e1ebad83197b4b3cf5cf16fe.jpg[/img] After overcoming countless challenges, exploring hostile lands in a dying world, and triumphing over the terrible Necros and perhaps even Toross Mordal himself, your odyssey is nearing its end… Before you turn the page on this chapter in your adventure, make sure you save the fruits of your labor by transferring your progress to Classic Mode!   [h2][u]How to Transfer Your Progress[/u][/h2] There are two ways to transfer your progress: [list] [*][b]If you had a Platinum Pass for the event,[/b] the service is free. All you need to do is activate it when you log in to Classic Mode and confirm the transfer.[/*] [*][b]If you didn't have a Platinum Pass during the event,[/b] you can spend 450 gems when you log in to Classic Mode to confirm the transfer of your progress.[/*][/list] The process is [b]easy and transparent;[/b] with it, you can continue your adventure where you left off but in Classic Mode this time. A tooltip will show on your screen the first time you log in, and the service will be available in the game menu (Escape key) if you want to take some time to think about it.   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f8cfbef4c773e26db534c0aaab837ae4c401098e.png[/img]     [h2][u]How Long Is the Service Available?[/u][/h2] The progress transfer service is [b]only available for a limited time.[/b] It will be active until the next Krosmic Mode begins. After that point, all progress will have been reset and there will be not way to recover it. Note that if you acquired the progress transfer service with a Platinum Pass or by getting the service alone, it will activate automatically when the next Krosmic Mode begins.   [h2][u]What Gets Transferred from Krosmic Mode to Classic Mode?[/u][/h2]   [h3]Shop Purchases[/h3][list] [*]All items and services bought in the Shop using gems or real currency are already shared across Classic Mode and Krosmic Mode, including hero and deck slots, alternative and chromatic skins, world and combat visual effects, etc.[/*][/list]   [h3]This list below only concerns players who have purchased a Platinum Battle Pass for the event, or who bought the progress transfer service for 450 gems.[/h3]   [h3]Heroes[/h3][list] [*]All active heroes in Krosmic Mode will be transferred as-is to Classic Mode. Heroes are considered to be active if they weren't deleted.[/*][/list]  When you transfer your progress to Classic Mode, if you are short on character slots, [b]temporary slots will be lent to you.[/b] These temporary slots aren't limited in time or quantity. That way, you can continue to play all your heroes. However, you will no longer be able to create new heroes until you've unlocked enough permanent character slots cover your heroes.   [h3]Resources[/h3][list] [*]All your accumulated resources – including kamas, chests, runes, Wakfu fragments, keys, etc. – will be transferred.[/*][/list]  

Equipment[/h3][list] [*][b]Equipment that you do not[/b] [b]yet have in Classic Mode[/b] will be transferred as-is, including level and unlocked skills.[/*] [*]For [b]equipment that you already have in Classic Mode,[/b] only the highest level item will be conserved. All resources invested in the lower level item will be refunded, including the number of copies, kamas and runes. Copies not yet invested in the item will also be transferred.[/*][/list]   [h3]World Progress and Quest Points (QPs)[/h3][list] [*]All overall progress (World and QP) will be transferred as-is.[/*][/list]   [h3]Story Mode Progress[/h3][list] [*]All your progress in Story Mode – if you hadn't started or exceeded it in Classic Mode – will be transferred as-is.[/*][/list]   [h3]Logbook Achievements

[list] [*]Achievements are transferred as-is.[/*][/list]   [h3]First-Time Rewards[/h3][list] [*]First-time rewards (FTRs) are transferred as-is.[/*][/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/ddf45aac222cc27f3bb2fd6393a5277c32d679dd.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6fb47986debdb561849a698e3a2dd10a05e79a6c.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/33365784b6c36ae8798e3d94911fe4dd04a14b17.png[/img] All [u]un[/u]good things must come to an end, especially Necros!

notes.title: Spotlight on… grey_cellz!
notes.notes:
To keep celebrating the arrival of the new Paladir heroes, WAVEN has teamed up with [b]grey_cellz,[/b] a concept artist and background director, who's bringing a touch of magic (and above all his talent) to the World of Twelve with his artistic vision of these new heroes, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/51612fde06f4c14b32621cafba0dbe87b70a2e82.jpg[/img]

[b]WAVEN also means breaking new ground and exploring new horizons![/b]
 

At Ankama, our artists have the proudly vexing habit of dazzling our (and your) eyes. It is their talent and creativity that makes our universe so unique and magnificent. To dazzle you even more, and because we don't like limiting ourselves, all it takes is for a creative star outside our walls in Roubaix to dazzle us, and we won't want to let the star get away!
 

Vincent "grey_cellz" Nghiem is already a familiar face to us, since he's a background director at Studio No Border, our Tokyo-based friends that brought you Monster Slaughter and Dragon Parks, among others. This time, the artist was asked to take on a totally different challenge. He's brought his distinctive style and inspiring perspective to the skins for the new Paladir heroes by offering his own versions.

 
In close collaboration with WAVEN's artistic super teams, the illustrator has therefore left his emblematic mark on five heroes in the World of Twelve!


Since we love promoting creativity, and because we also love sharing it with you, [b]other collaborations with equally talented artists are to be expected![/b]

 
[b]Diversity is so stunning that it'd be a shame to do without it…[/b]

 
[h2][u]ABOUT THE ARTIST[/u][/h2]
If you want to learn more about his work (and let him know how much you love it), look him up on social media:

[list]	[*][b]Instagram:[/b] [url=https://www.instagram.com/grey_cellz/]https://www.instagram.com/grey_cellz/[/url][/*][/list] 
[b]Hats off to him![/b]

 
[h2][u]ULTIMATE KITS FOR EACH PALADIR![/u][/h2]
In addition getting these new skins in the appearance selection interface for the price of [b]1,500 gems[/b] each, you can also get them in [b]Ultimate Kits[/b] available in the [b]in-game Shop.[/b] Each of these Ultimate Kits contains the two new hero skins (male and female) and a [b]brand-new world visual effect:[/b]

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2343650?emclan=103582791473570552&emgid=4173222095294340178][b]Learn more about Krosmic Mode – Necros here[/b][/url][/i]

notes.title: Spotlight on… GVanaka!
notes.notes:
To accompany the arrival of the new Paladir heroes, [b]WAVEN has teamed up with GVanaka,[/b] a freelance concept artist and illustrator, who's bringing a touch of magic (and above all his talent) to the World of Twelve with his artistic vision of these new heroes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/3e7097809e7f4b474ff0f4fd2c390a2fd610102a.jpg[/img]

[b]WAVEN also means breaking new ground and exploring new horizons![/b]
 

At Ankama, our artists have the proudly vexing habit of dazzling our (and your) eyes. It is their talent and creativity that makes our universe so unique and magnificent. To dazzle you even more, and because we don't like limiting ourselves, all it takes is for a creative star outside our walls in Roubaix to dazzle us and we won't want to let the star get away!


Spotted and then contacted by ToT (head of Ankama) himself, Gary "GVanaka" Vanaka has done us the honor of answering our call. He's brought his distinctive style and inspiring perspective to the skins for the new Paladir heroes by offering his own versions.


In close collaboration with WAVEN's artistic super teams, the illustrator has therefore left his emblematic mark on five heroes in the World of Twelve!


Since we love promoting creativity, and because we also love sharing it with you, [b]other collaborations with equally talented artists are to be expected![/b]
 

[b]Diversity is so stunning that it'd be a shame to do without it…[/b]

notes.title: Five new heroes, a new zone, and a sizeable challenge: Krosmic Mode!
notes.notes:
[i]The World of Twelve is facing a new threat, a danger more terrifying than ever! A world on the edge of ruin harbors the greatest evil possible… A portal to the Necroworld has appeared in WAVEN, and it's your duty to contain what it holds![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/02bdc3e18da0ceb7a1d11c1545c3e4797c2f79b1.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]The Necro Invasion: Krosmic Event[/u][/h2]

[b]From Tuesday, April 9, to Tuesday, June 4,[/b] play [b]Krosmic Mode,[/b] a new and unique event in WAVEN!

Play as one of the [b]Paladir heroes[/b] (or one of the heroes already available), enter the [b]Necroworld,[/b] fight your way through each quarter of this dark place to face each [b]Necro[/b] [b]guardian,[/b] then reach the door that leads to the [b]final confrontation:[/b] [b]Toross Mordal,[/b] the king of this ruined world.

 

[b]A disastrous fate looms over the World of Twelve…[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/8d3e81386bea130bdc7b44c18fc8857f40a49e2f.png[/img]

[h2][u]New Heroes to Change the Course of Destiny![/u][/h2]

To confront this immense threat, [b]five new illustrious heroes[/b] – [b]the Paladirs[/b] – have joined the ranks of heroes representing each class:
[list]	[*][b]Hioplite Paladir,[/b] in the Iop class[/*]	[*][b]Arcarius Paladir,[/b] in the Cra class[/*]	[*][b]Zinetritos Paladir,[/b] in the Xelor class[/*]	[*][b]Okus Piktus Paladir,[/b] in the Eniripsa class[/*]	[*][b]Sicarius Paladir,[/b] in the Sram class[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/c7c4fdf377c3f5927d91139a4d97994391bdad1e.jpg[/img]

[i]Early access to these new characters is available in this new temporary game mode. After the event has finished, they will permanently join the roster of heroes available in the classic game mode.[/i]

 

[b]Start an adventure from scratch,[/b] level up your hero in this [b]new and disturbing world,[/b] gain enough power and quest points to [b]unlock access to the Necroworld,[/b] then cross the threshold of what could become the [b]final resting place for Twelvians…[/b]

 

[b]The fate of the World of Twelve rests on your shoulders![/b]

[i]Your Classic Mode heroes, items and resources won't be available in Krosmic Mode. Only cosmetic items are shared between the two game modes. To access Krosmic Mode, select it from the server selection screen.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/cc847c5ebff4bed827acec34e92a037597d2baa0.png[/img][i]Classic Mode to Krosmic Mode[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/36e7623d59ac368a089aa490e1a62eb0254740ce.png[/img][i]Krosmic Mode to Classic Mode[/i]
 
[h2][u]The Necroworld: A Kingdom of Desolation[/u][/h2]

In the gloomy lands of the Necroworld, Wakfu is nothing but a distant memory. Here, only destructive energy – Stasis – reigns, altering everything that was previously alive.

 

Toross Mordal's fallen kingdom was once full of life. Now it's nothing more than a depleted land of ruin and desolation, where only relics frozen in time remain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/67589577fc5d236d9141c692bfa275f962dfefff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9c16dbd7d8b548f7f514ef347047b09498a98bce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f4e4d409d1371f187922c94b07cefbac061ab409.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/304dd9d786fa538446b320c809b13ffa8b367576.png[/img]

At the top of this macabre world, King Toross rules over the Necros, implacable beings, gluttonous devourers of Wakfu, and maddened by purplish energy. They are the only people in the Necroworld. Their emaciated forms and gnashing jaws make them easily recognizable, and they sow terror wherever they go.

 

Although dark and sinister, Toross Mordal bears the burden of guilt for the sad and cursed fate of his people. As he tries to guide his subjects through worlds, he tirelessly continues his quest for a source of Wakfu that could quench their insatiable hunger, in the hope of finding some semblance of redemption…

 

[i]The Necroworld is a new expansion that will be added to WAVEN's Classic Mode at the end of the Krosmic Mode event.[/i]

[h2][u]Necroworld Quarters: Puzzles and Fights[/u][/h2]
In WAVEN, [b]each quarter[/b] of the Necroworld corresponds to a [b]level range.[/b] To access the next quarter, you need to complete [b]five specific rooms[/b] in the preceding quarter.

 

Throughout your [b]solo[/b] journey in the various rooms, you'll face [b]puzzles and special fights[/b] that try to prevent you from reaching the area's guardian. To move from one room to another, you need to [b]use keys[/b] that you've gained as rewards. Certain rooms require more keys to be opened than others: It's [b]your choice[/b] how you want to fight your way through!

 

Necros won't be the only opponents you face. Each quarter is also infested with a specific [b]monster family.[/b] The further you progress, the more Necros you [b]face in combat,[/b] which increases the difficulty.

 

[i]Once a quarter has been completed, a new unique path will open up within, presenting even tougher challenges as well as rewards worthy of the feat…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6fbb87f0c43d8b8b2cc9950c33ad194ea49bd9e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/dee310f38d733538cafd6bcbeceea2a4a0249f0c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e4ac5f59fef019998ca672d9d5345a405f75b157.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/4a867c7b73fdf346677278932ddf025aaa4a0646.png[/img]

[h2][u]Behind Toross Mordal's Door: The Final Battle[/u][/h2]

At the heart of the Necroworld, [b]Toross Mordal's door[/b] awaits, locked. It will only open once all the guardians have been defeated. When the required conditions have been met, the Necro king will stand firmly against you over [b]several chapters[/b] of increasing difficulty. However, you only have [b]one attempt per day[/b] to subdue Toross Mordal and [b]save the World of Twelve[/b] from disaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/042ff804947c9249f8ae465deb94618ef077629e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6e7a4f79590abdc0ec91c1f9959f1d68cf9b5e49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6e956e09f2431c723c447f06f44fc9a8e4ff1f1d.png[/img]

[b]You'll never make it alone…[/b]

 

[i]The fights behind Toross Mordal's door have been designed to be fought in co-op with other players, but they can be attempted solo. They are divided into six sequential chapters, from level 100 to level 150.[/i]

 
[h2][u]Rewards: A Special System[/u][/h2]

In the Necroworld, you only earn rewards once per fight. In other words, [b]only first-time rewards (FTR)[/b] are granted. However, with each attempt in Toross Mordal's realm, you can earn [b]Wakfu Fragments[/b] if you win.

 
[h2][u]Companions, Equipment and Spells: New Necromic Items[/u][/h2]

With the Necroworld, [b]new[/b] "[b]Necromic[/b]" items have arrived. You can get them from [b]rotating loot[/b] on WAVEN's islands and monsters as well as from [b]Kabrok and Miranda's Shop.[/b] Miranda will run her own counter, and her items will be sold individually for Wakfu Fragments. [b]Eight spells,[/b] [b]five companions,[/b] [b]four rings[/b] and [b]an armband[/b] will be added to the game.

 
The World of Twelve needs heroes!
Stop the Necros from sealing its fate…
 

 
[h2][u]Transfer Your Progress[/u][/h2]

At the end of the [b]Krosmic Mode[/b] event, a service will be available in the [b]shop[/b] to [b]transfer all the progress you made*[/b] (heroes, items, resources) to [b]Classic Mode.[/b] This service will only be available for a [b]limited time[/b] in exchange for Gems. It will also be included for free with the Platinum Passes that cover the event (April 9 to June 4).

*The WAVEN team reserves the right to make adjustments to the quantities transferred to Classic Mode if necessary.

notes.title: The World of Twelve's Balance Is Threatened…
notes.notes:
The krosmic balance is teetering dangerously as a dark presence spreads throughout WAVEN. The bravest adventurers will need to join forces to contain the shadows threatening the World of Twelve's fragile balance. Fearsome challenges and epic battles await and the very future of Twelvian humanity hangs in the balance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/08b85ba6beb6c005e1bb148a95dc36c3ad06dca1.jpg[/img]

The krosmic balance is teetering dangerously as a dark presence spreads throughout WAVEN. The bravest adventurers will need to join forces to contain the shadows threatening the World of Twelve's fragile balance. Fearsome challenges and epic battles await and the very future of Twelvian humanity hangs in the balance.


[b]Only a force of rare bravery can overcome this imminent threat. Only illustrious saviors and heroes will be able to push back the growing darkness…[/b]


WAVEN heroes, get ready to plunge into the shadows and defend the World of Twelve from an impending invasion!
 

[b]On April 9, the future of the World of Twelve will be in your hands!*[/b]
 

[u]* This temporary event will happen directly in the game when you choose "Krosmic Mode" on the login screen. More information will be coming soon.[/u]

notes.title: Season Kit: An Eggcellent Offer!
notes.notes:
From [b]March 26 until 10 a.m. on April 2 (CEST),[/b] ring in spring with this eggcellent offer! The [b]weekly rotation[/b] in the [b]WAVEN Shop[/b] is full of treats that that'd coax even the most colorful egg out of hiding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/4e4e27a3000e04675fef2eadb50070855e61a4c1.jpg[/img]

In the World of Twelve, when the first spring buds sprout and the flowers in Ogrest's prairie begin to bloom, nature begins to dance throughout all of Astrub. Under the sparkling eyes of fluffy critters and to the sound of tinkling bells, the castaways trade chocolate treats. These treats bearing colorful decorations come in the form of tofu eggs (even tofurby eggs, for those with the biggest sweet tooths) – even perhaps dragon eggs, for the most audacious among you – and a few super-sweet praline bells…


[b]All this is a sure sign that spring has sprung![/b]


To celebrate Twelvian spring, get your hands on the new cosmetic items in the [b]Season Kit:[/b]
[list]	[*]Wodent Ears [b]headgear[/b][/*]	[*]Spinning Egg [b]halo[/b][/*]	[*]Springy Bell [b]trail[/b][/*]	[*]Colored Egg [b] tracks[/b][/*][/list] 
Offered at the amazing discount price of [b]1,200 gems[/b] instead of 2,400, this [b]complete Kit[/b] is only available for a [b]limited time![/b]
 

[b]Stop walking on eggshells and hurry straight to the WAVEN in-game Shop to get your hands on this [i]eggcellent[/i] offer![/b]

Great news! The [b]party game[/b] from Ankama and Doryah Games is now available. Get set for limitless fun!

What about the [b]Visitor from the Future[/b] or [b]Sherlock Homes?[/b]

notes.title: Saint Patrick's Day Kit: Green Light for Fun!
notes.notes:
From [b]March 12 until 9:00 a.m. (CET) on March 19,[/b] the World of Twelve will be awash with green, as will the [b]WAVEN Shop![/b] The [b]weekly rotation[/b] will offer a bit of [u]greenery[/u] to brighten up your adventure. How could anyone resist?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/ff0be33c4a98356d8c8a2faa757b79c927cc17b8.png[/img]

Another Pandawa celebration... Any tradition is a good excuse for a celebration! Throughout the World of Twelve, the bamboo milk is flowing, voices are raised in song, and people are swaying happily to folk dances. Who's worrying about what tomorrow might bring? No one... except the innkeeper!

[b]Celebrate Saint Patrick's Day in WAVEN![/b]

Raise a toast to your past and future adventures (as long as your luck holds out) and don your greenest finery [b]now[/b] with this [b]Saint Patrick's Day Kit:[/b]

notes.title: An Epic Showdown for Chapter 2 of WAVEN: The Wakfu Season!
notes.notes:
[h1]Take on Efrim and the Necro threat[/h1]

Engage in an intense fratricidal duel between Adamai and Efrim, two mighty dragons directly descended from a god  of the Krosmoz.  
Make strategic use of Adamai's devastating spells to try and stay alive for 5 turns, inflicting the heaviest losses on the Necro army,  and come away with amazing rewards!

[h1]Discover the new Pass rewards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/96d5218bc0191620d97cbc07462b80fa883ee3fe.jpg[/img]

Along with this new chapter, there's the new Gold Pass and Platinum Pass, which let you customize your WAVEN adventure even more by unlocking:
[list]
[*] An Efrim pet who means well. 
[*] Two sets of draconic visual effects for showing off in combat or in the hub.
[*] Four Efrim emotes.
[*] A new companion skin for Adamai.
[*] Season tickets so you can take on Efrim and his army.
[*] Gems you can use to buy your favorite cosmetic items from WAVEN's in-game shop.
[/list]
[h1]Treat Yourself to the Drhell's Bells Pack[/h1]

Continue your adventure under the sign of fortune by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781060/]adopting this adorable Drheller[/url] who'll love you and offer you a few gems that it unearthed somewhere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6ff3dd4ec1fad4729aa19a0e3e382074746e3a03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Necros are invading the time portal, and they won't stop until the World of Twelve is destroyed… Will you stand up to them?[/b]

notes.title: Pack: Drhell's Bells – Adopt a Little Drheller!
notes.notes:
Small, extremely furry, oddly shaped, and above all increadiby endearing... It'll follow you everywhere! Just look at those big adorable eyes begging to go adventuring with you – adopt an adorable [b]Baby Drheller Pet[/b] from the [b]WAVEN Shop![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6ff3dd4ec1fad4729aa19a0e3e382074746e3a03.jpg[/img]

Symbol of fortune, Drhellers have long been faithful companions to treasure hunters throughout the World of Twelve. Despite the rising waters, Drhellers continue to be seen beside intrepid adventurers seeking hidden treasures. And guess what? Our little fur ball has gotten its paws on quite a trove...

With the [b]Drhell's Bells Pack,[/b] you'll be on a lucky streak because it contains:
[list]	[*]a [b]Baby Drheller Pet[/b][/*]	[*]300 [b]Gems[/b][/*][/list]
Adopting this incredible critter and getting your hands on its treasure is only possible with [b]real currency.[/b] The adoption formalities happen [b]directly in the game[/b] or via [b]Steam[/b].

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781060]Don't miss this unique opportunity to add a touch of cuteness to your adventure in the world of WAVEN![/url][/b]

notes.title: Yugo Kit: The Magic of Wakfu!
notes.notes:
Between [b]March 5th and March 12th (9 a.m. CET / 3 a.m. US-ET),[/b] harness the magic of Wakfu and reveal your inner Eliatrope child to the World of Twelve! The [b]Yugo Kit[/b] is now available in the weekly rotation of the [b]WAVEN Shop[/b] for a [b]limited time.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/6ef28693211fdf8aeb66a0e47cbe60aeb109368e.png[/img]

In the World of Twelve, Wakfu magic embodies the very essence of life, the driving force of all creation. It's a primordial energy of the Krosmoz, in contrast with Stasis, the energy of destruction. Under the protection of the goddess Eliatrope, the Eliatrope people – led by the Eliatrope king Yugo – have mastered its secrets. Recognizable by their long head coverings which hold two Wakfu wings, the Eliatropes travel the world by opening dimensional portals and wield weapons imbued with the bluish energy, leaving a glowing mark in every dimension they traverse.

[b]Don your Eliatrope garb and join up with the people of the forgotten![/b]

[b]Starting now,[/b] you can discover the legacy of the Eliatropes with the [b]Yugo Kit,[/b] which features [b]four unique cosmetic items:[/b]
[list]	[*]Wakfu Wings [b]Headgear[/b][/*]	[*]Eliatrope Portals [b]Halo[/b][/*]	[*]Wakfu Magic [b]Trail[/b][/*]	[*]Wakfu Stream [b]Tracks[/b][/*][/list]
Offered at the [b]amazing discount price[/b] of [b]1,200 gems[/b] instead of 2,400, this [b]complete kit[/b] is only available for a [b]limited time![/b]

[b]Go straight to the in-game shop to get your Yugo Kit, and embrace the magic of Wakfu! Adventure is calling you to WAVEN – so dive in![/b]

notes.title: Check out the New WAKFU-Themed Season with Chapter 1: Lokus
notes.notes:
The [i]WAKFU[/i] phenomenon has made port in WAVEN for an anthology season! Over the next few months, this [i]WAKFU[/i]-themed season will be bringing new content in a series of four chapters, starting with [i]Chapter 1: Lokus[/i], available now through March 12!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/ea320ec0a3c4b45f0e76a3a0cb2482a66fe36f13.jpg[/img]

[h1]A "Series-ly" Fun Season[/h1]

Six years after the broadcast of season 3, [i]WAKFU[/i] is back and better than ever with 14 new episodes being broadcast simultaneously worldwide! Catch up with the Brotherhood of the Tofu years before the events in WAVEN, after an epic clash against Oropo and against themselves. Our heroes reach Ingloriom, the realm of the gods of the World of Twelve, not prepared for what they find there…
[i]WAKFU[/i] season 4 is available on France Télévisions starting on February 9 , with two episodes per week! To celebrate, WAVEN's jumping onto the WAKFU bandwagon with several chapters that will bring new fights, new heroes and even a brand-new season mode over the course of a few months!

[h1]Use Your Portals to Survive the Season Fight[/h1]

In this first chapter, play as Qilby, a being capable of opening portals to move about in a dimension, and fight Lokus, a guardian of unknown origins who's as enigmatic as he is powerful.
Qilby's fighting abilities are well-known, but his powers might not be enough against Lokus… Can you survive five rounds against him?

[h1]Check Out the New Season Goals[/h1]

This new season brings a new twist to how progress is handled in WAVEN's Passes. Objectives that are not linked to the season fight are now diverse challenges that can be completed in any fight, rather than only on a specific island. It's time to test your combat skills!

Complete these objectives to win the Battle Pass rewards with, in addition to the free Pass, the Gold and Platinum Passes that give you access to new cosmetic items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9997660ddf5cc47a9c8dd072f8998020f280714c.jpg[/img]

Obtain these passes from WAVEN's in-game shop and get:
[list]
[*] a Lokus pet that'll always have its eyes on you
[*] two sets of visual effects to customize your fights and exploration of WAVEN's islands
[*] four Lokus emotes, because a picture's worth a thousand words
[*] a new companion skin for Qilby
[*] season tickets for more chances to make it to the top of the season rankings
[*] gems, WAVEN's cosmetic currency to show off your style
[/list]
[h1]Check Out New Offers to Customize Your Adventure[/h1]

New cosmetics are available this month in the WAVEN in-game shop to celebrate Saint Valentine's Day and the Lunar New Year! Get these visual effects in two custom packs, from February 13 through 20, and from February 20 through 27!

notes.notes:
[h1]1. WHAT'S NEW[/h1]

[list]
[*] The chests sold at Kabrok's Shop have been raised to level 100.
[*] The chest interface now lets you sort by category.
[*] A button has been added to make opening chests faster.
[/list]
[h1]2. GENERAL[/h1]
The "Spell Damage" notion has been separated into:
[list]
[*] elemental spell damage, and
[*] spell damage.
[/list]
 
[i]The notion was confusing, notably when it came to Ether spells.[/i]

[list]
[*] Spell damage now applies to Ether spells that impact a Hero's Attack.
[*] Armor gain bonuses now apply to spells and effects of this type: "Gains X% of your hero's ATTACK as ARMOR."
[*] Heal bonuses now apply to spells and effects of this type: "Heals your hero X% of their ATTACK."
[/list]
[h3]Peat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Armor Gain: 11 → 8
[/list]
[i]Builds focusing on Peat effects were more powerful than those playing Fire or Air.[/i]
 
[h3]Rebound[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 11 → 13
[/list]
[h3]Explosion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage: 11 → 14
[/list]
In order to improve the game tutorial, the default decks in all classes have been reworked. The intent of having spells with simple mechanics has been kept. We've added a few spells with class mechanics, a spell that applies an elemental state, and a spell that consumes it to gain auras. This lets players discover all the class passives, general mechanics and certain combinations, while remaining relatively simple.

[list]
[*] Health Steal effects now function when the target has Armor.
[*] End-of-season rewards linked to the seasonal fight rankings have been updated. Albuera Chests, which could previously be obtained, have been replaced by their equivalent in Wakfu Fragments.
[/list]
[h1]3. CHARACTERS[/h1]
[h2]Multiclass Spells[/h2]
[i]Albuera spells have added a lot to the game, especially by providing real interest with Gauge + Magic gameplay. We think that this archetype is slightly too powerful, but we do not want to limit its capacity to generate a large quantity of gauges and, as a result, do considerable damage with these spells.[/i]

notes.title: A new free hero is coming with Whisperer Season!
notes.notes:
The Whisperers will be invading WAVEN until February 13 in this new start-of-year season. And to keep them company, the Astramantis heroes are now available for free for everyone. Give them a try! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/7c388a1d0679c69e83c2d4e2819ada08861090b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Play These New Waven Heroes for Free [/h1]

The Astramantises were first seen in an early access sneak peek during the Albuera season and are now available to all WAVEN players in the character creation menu. Play as one of these powerful Iops and make good use of their unique "Mantis Leap" passive to throw yourself into the thick of the battle! 

To accompany the official release of these new heroes, we collaborated with Tony Valente, the author of the manga Radiant, to offer you the ultimate skin. Get yours now with gems in the in-game shop!

Don't be fooled by appearances. Whisperers are mysterious tiny beings who work in groups. They've taken more than one by surprise.

notes.title: Exploring WAVEN #3 – The Music
notes.notes:
[i]"WAVEN is written in the spirit of the times, kind of like a mirror of society's problems. And that was a big deal for me, writing this music, because it isn't just innocuous background music – it's meant to narrate something that reflects our feelings, our fears…"[/i]

[b]Pitch – Ankama's audio director –[/b] welcomes you into his lair, the birthplace of the [b]musical themes[/b] that embellish your adventures in the World of Twelve. [b]Music[/b] plays a [b]crucial role[/b] by harmonizing the universe; every track, every theme, every melody, whether more eclectic or more intimate, contributes to the game's [b]unique and charming atmosphere[/b]. By breathing life into the rhythm of his notes, Pitch orchestrates his stories and interpretations of the various emotions that mark your odyssey, reciting an [b]unforgettable score[/b] to accompany you as you conquer WAVEN.

[previewyoutube=UZiNO7aQ9BI;full][/previewyoutube]

This episode is available on[url=https://www.youtube.com/@WAVEN_GAME] our official YouTube channel[/url], with subtitles in [b]English[/b], French, German, Portuguese, and Spanish.

[b]Keep your eyes on the horizon and look out for future episodes exploring other fascinating aspects of WAVEN![/b]

notes.title: Check out what's new in the Lance Dur season – Chapter 3: Albuera!
notes.notes:
WAVEN's sailing high with this update! With the addition of story mode, a new island nation, new quests, and a new hero in an exclusive sneak preview in the Platinum Pass, there's a tidal wave of new content in this update! It's also the last chapter of the Lance Dur season, which will bring our old hero's last adventure to a close, and things will take a surprising turn, to say the least…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9ffa7e771b307faa46ed9c1b2547637c54ff4513.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dive into the New WAVEN Content[/h1]
The main quest has come to shore in WAVEN! Head out on an adventure with 40 intense chapters in which you investigate the mysterious rift in Astrub and discover a secret about the gods' disappearance. A secret strangely linked to a single family…

In addition to the narrative storyline, discover Amakna, a new emblematic island nation in the World of Twelve, which comes with 15 new, original quests. More generally, WAVEN has added additional side quests, numerous achievements and many more features such as an open chat, linking the skill tree to decks, and separate balancing for PvE and PvP!

Finally, brand new heroes have entered the game: the Astramantises. Like Lance Dur, the Astramantises are relentless warriors who wield powerful lances to defeat their enemies. This sixth hero in the Iop class has a unique passive and  can be played by players with a Platinum Pass in an early access sneak peek!

[b]And that's not all! Rumors coming out of Lance Dur's court say that another island might well appear in early January… Which would put a whole new twist on the Albuera chapter![/b]

[h1]The Ultimate Battle at the Time Portal[/h1]
Season fights continue on Competitive Island. The Lance Dur season is coming to a close, and the final chapter is upon us. After the terrible Cire Momore and Belladonna, your opponent is now… Lance Dur himself! Play as an Astramantis warrior and face off against your own king until January 16 to win Wakfu fragments, chests, gems and much more.

Complete season goals both liked to the portal and not to earn Season Points that let you win free rewards in the Battle Pass. Whether you decide to fight it out in the competitive ladder or choose to fight in the many dungeons in WAVEN, how you unlock your rewards is up to you!

[h1]Get All the New Cosmetic Items in WAVEN[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/537a10ac869e1dc79b96be907f3540583290938c.jpg[/img]

Get the Gold or Platinum Pass now and get:
[list]
[*] a Lance Dur Whisperer pet who'll faithfully accompany you on your adventures
[*] a set of visual effects worthy of the Kingdom of Albuera to show off in combat and in the WAVEN hub
[*] Astramantis lance emotes to give a touch of class to your communication with other adventurers
[*] season tickets giving you more opportunities to fight in the season portal
[*] and a large number of gems to get your hands on skins, visual effects and emotes in the WAVEN in-game shop!
[*] Each Pass has its own reward timeline, and the Platinum Pass unlocks them all! If you missed the start of the season, you can still collect all the rewards at any time, as long as you've got enough Season Points.
[/list]
All these rewards can only be unlocked in the Pass while Chapter 3: Albuera lasts, so make sure you've unlocked everything before it's too late! And don't worry – if you've got enough Season Points but you forget to collect your cosmetic rewards, they'll be waiting for you in an in-game letter when the next chapter begins. Season tickets, however, can only be used for the current chapter, so get ready to do battle!

[b]Lance Dur, the legendary Count of Albuera Island, has issued a challenge in your name. En garde, Heroes![/b]

notes.title: WAVEN Livestream Recap – December 6
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1997482858]WATCH THE REPLAY IN ENGLISH[/url]

[h1]A LOOK BACK FROM THE EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH TO NOW[/h1]

WAVEN has welcomed over 500,000 unique players since August 16. That's a very encouraging number for what comes next and the game's potential. As we write this, we've received over 90% positive reviews on Steam, despite a launch that was slowed down by major latency issues on the North American server.


At the same time, we're aware that players are now waiting for additional content, which (among other factors) explains why a part of the community has left the game for now.

As we come to the end of this early access period, our goal is to offer the most complete and polished version of the game. There's been a lot to learn in this preliminary stage, and it's pushed us to make consistent efforts at improvement. Here are a few of the major areas that still need work:
[list]
[*] An early game that offers a better introduction for new players
[*] A need for late-game content
[*] More development of social interactions
[*] Usability improvements for certain features, such as opening reward chests
[*] More diverse customization options for heroes
[*] And other areas of improvement…
[/list]
This handful of areas has generally been mentioned by our very devoted community, as well as by players who have already jumped ship. So based on this feedback, we've come up with a plan of action for the next few WAVEN updates.

[h1]UPDATE 0.14[/h1]
[h3][u]Astramantis Pike, Our New Hero[/u][/h3]

October 24 marked the start of the special Lance Dur season, divided into three chapters, with the December 19 update providing the conclusion to the trilogy. In this third and final chapter, you'll play as a new hero from the Iop class, Astramantis Pike, to face off against Lance Dur, the ex-protagonist from previous seasons.

This new hero's strength lies in his mobility. Able to teleport right next to any enemy he chooses, he has four lancer spells and gameplay based on positioning and the ability to summon allied companions.

[b]Astramantis Pike will be available early for Battle Pass holders with the Platinum Pass, and available for everyone later in 2024.[/b]


[h3][u]The Transmedia Island Nation of Albuera[/u][/h3]

Designed for experienced players to introduce late-game content, with battles at levels 100 and up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/b89faf387017055b9b15ae47da38d0778348dc5f.png[/img]

This island won't be available when the update is rolled out, but will open in the course of the season. We want to polish it up a bit more before letting you explore it.

Five quests ranging from levels 104 to 120 will be available on the island, including two dungeons where you'll face Belladonna and Cire Momore in a different format than the one you tried out in the Time Portal. We intentionally made these two dungeons smaller than the ones on the monster islands, with just 2 or 3 three rooms, so you can get to the boss fight that much faster. They're also designed to be harder!

Once Albuera Island opens, you will no longer be able to obtain Albuera Chests from other monster islands (as a world drop), since they will be specific to Albuera Island. However, you will also still be able to buy them with Wakfu Fragments in Kabrok's Shop.


[h3][u]The Historic Island Nation of Amakna[/u][/h3]
The island nation of Amakna has been closed since the start of early access. In update 0.14, we're finally opening it to players!

Following the same formula as Bonta and Brakmar, it offers 15 quests ranging from levels 40 to 80. Their narrative aspect provides a lead-in to the main quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/2b3d138b97d6c6a0fa0eb90ae7f6a640be6a2b62.png[/img]

[h3][u]Main Storyline: The Castaway's Odyssey[/u][/h3]

The main quest will provide a consistent through-line for players' adventures and the entire narrative aspect of the game. The first few quests serve as a prologue for the overall main storyline that players will follow. So far, 40 quests have been integrated, building on and developing the initial story with Percedal and Ogrest.

[h3][u]PvE/PvP Balancing[/u][/h3]

As announced at the start of early access, we're now finally dissociating PvP balancing and PvE balancing. For this first iteration, we've been collaborating with two experienced players from the PvP mode who will continue to work with us in this big ongoing project.

With this new system, we can make distinct modifications for each game mode without affecting the other.

[h3][u]Open Chat[/u][/h3]

To strengthen WAVEN's social and community aspects, we are now opening a general chat channel. Players will no longer be required to use pre-written phrases that are automatically translated into the language of the game client. We recognize that despite its positive qualities, this feature was ultimately more frustrating than anything else. However, the pre-fab speech bubbles will still be available as "chat shortcuts" for those who may wish to continue using them.

[h1]MOBILE APP AND SOFT LAUNCH[/h1]

In September, we opened the WAVEN mobile app in various targeted territories to test out this version and collect usage data.

We're fairly satisfied with the general interface, but we don't think the application is quite ready for the open sea yet. We're still having trouble keeping players past the start of the game: 40% of mobile players quit before they make it past level 4.

The WAVEN mobile app is an important and even crucial aspect of the game, and we want to do everything we can to make sure it provides an optimal experience. Its official launch was originally planned for the end of 2023, in parallel with the official release of WAVEN, but in light of the points mentioned above, we prefer to continue improving the game as a whole and addressing players' needs before announcing a version 1.0 for mobile and PC.

[h1]UPCOMING PROJECTS[/h1]

We're very excited about 2024, not only because we're planning to put out lots of great content, but also because we hope to be able to make improvements on a variety of different fronts.

[h3][u]Temporary Servers for Temporary Game Modes[/u][/h3]

We want to offer unique temporary gameplay experiences for our players, then potentially integrate their unique features on the classic servers later on. For example, we might imagine rolling out new heroes on the temporary servers, and players could then recover their progress on the classic servers. Similarly, if we implement a sneak peek of a new game mode on these servers and the community likes it, we'll know that it can work on the classic servers too.

[h3][u]Asynchronous Mode: A New Approach[/u][/h3]

Previously, the asynchronous arena let players hire minions to defend their haven islands, while the players themselves could attack other players' haven islands. We're thinking about redefining this game mode, for example by letting players use boats to initiate asynchronous naval battles. Players would then send crews of monsters, previously collected on islands, to go and attack other boats and recover loot.

[h3][u]Battle Royale, A New Competitive Game Mode[/u][/h3]

This game mode would be a mix of PvP and PvE in a competitive setting. The goal would be to fight waves of monsters until only one survivor is left standing: the winner.

[h3][u]Heroic Quests, from Special Transmedia Chapters to the Main Storyline[/u][/h3]

In addition to the main storyline, we want to offer special chapters covering important moments in the stories of some of the most iconic characters in the Krosmoz, like Remington Smisse or Joris Jurgen. Players will play as these legends and experience their adventures firsthand.

[h1]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS[/h1]

[b]What can you tell us about upcoming classes and heroes?[/b]

We're planning to release two classes: Sacrier and Osamodas. The Sacrier is the next class on our calendar, and we'd like to roll it out in 2024. The Osamodas class, on the other hand, doesn't have a release date yet. Each will have five heroes, just like the current classes.

[b]How are you planning to improve co-op interactions?[/b]

We're aware that we can do better here, and we're exploring a variety of options. For example, we could extend some of a hero's effects to all group members instead of just the owner. A Kokoro could apply armor to all group members instead of just one target, or the Peat could apply to all allies instead of just their one character.

We are also looking into multiplayer game modes that would play differently than fights against Monarchs and Elite monsters.

[b]How does the team decide if a hero is too strong or too weak?[/b]

We follow guidelines based – in part – on statistical data. In particular, we monitor whether various combinations of passives and heroes allow players to achieve a certain percentage of victories in specific fights. We try to aim for a victory rate of around 75%, give or take about 5%. If a given combination diverges too far from the target, then it probably needs to be rebalanced.

[b]Are you considering the possibility of differentiating utility spells (1/2/3 AP) from damage-dealing spells?[/b]

Spell cost balancing is based on a table with automatically calculated values. For example, if we change the damage value of low-cost spells, the tool determines its balanced weight. For the time being, we have no plans to make any changes to low-cost spells.

[b]Will it be possible to view other players' decks, or even to trade with them using a shareable code?[/b]

This isn't in our plans for the short term, but it's an interesting feature to consider.
[b]
Will it be possible to dissociate the skill trees from the passives for a given character?[/b]

For update 0.14, the skills table will be linked to the chosen deck, not to the hero. It will be possible to buy multiple deck slots using gems, and they will be unlocked for the account.

[b]What do you think about the overall balance between MAGIC-oriented and ATTACK-oriented builds?[/b]

At the start of early access, the vast majority of builds were focused on ATTACK, and this tendency has been decreasing as we progress through more cycles of balancing. ATTACK is a very easy stat to increase in the early game because it's boosted by common items. At higher and higher levels of game content, however, MAGIC builds (especially those based on companions) become more and more useful. We're not entirely satisfied with the balance at present, but we are fairly pleased with the direction it's headed in.

[b]Will it be possible to deactivate certain skill improvements on items once we've bought them?[/b]

We have no plans for this at present, but we're aware that certain situations resulting from these can be frustrating to players. We're thinking about possible solutions.

[b]Are you planning to improve the rewards for group fights?[/b]

Not at this time. We feel that what's most rewarding about playing in a group is the ability to get through content that would be difficult or impossible to complete on your own.

[b]Well it be possible to speed up the spell animations?[/b]

We're aware of the problem, and it's a topic that the community regularly brings to our attention. One thing we're sure of is that we don't want to let people play without animations. But we're considering other solutions.

[b]It's currently impossible to cause collision damage against the outside edges of the game board. Do you have a solution in mind?[/b]

We know that this type of combat interaction could be improved, but it would require the involvement of the dev team. We'll be looking into this.

[b]Will you be changing the random aspect of rune drops from Monarchs?[/b]

For the time being, we're satisfied with the current state of this part of the game.

[b]Will it be possible to see the order of summonees in the fight timeline?[/b]

This would require changes to the interface, and no such changes are planned in the short term.

[b]What's happening with max-level items that can be collected from chests?[/b]

This is a complicated issue for which we don't yet have a satisfactory solution. We're continuing to look into different possibilities.

[b]What's your vision for the late game?[/b]

We want to offer players some very difficult fights, and possibly an interface for fights at levels going up to infinity. We want to reward engaged players and test their skills with particularly tough challenges. This is a general vision of what we want to achieve, and will still need to be refined.

[b]What are haven islands good for?[/b]

For now, not a whole lot. We want to rework them to give them a clear value for players. We're currently at the very start of our thought process here, and we'll dive into the issue seriously in 2024.

[b]What about guilds?[/b]

This feature is still in the pipeline, and we want to do something ambitious with it. However, they definitely won't be available in the short term.

[b]Are you planning to make any changes to season fights that are especially long?[/b]

We're aware that the current format can be quite time-consuming. The next fight will be much shorter and more punishing. We're also planning changes to the scoring system. However, we have no plans for now to change the rewards. We feel that if the fight is shorter, the rewards have more value.

[b]Are you planning any ornaments that would be representative of our level or our equipment?[/b]

Maybe…

[b]What are your thoughts about Daily Quests?[/b]

The system was initially intended to get players interested in connecting every day through fun, fast, simple quests offering an easy way to get rewards. Since then, with the addition of the Battle Pass, Wakfu Fragments, the daily gift in the Shop, etc., DQs have lost that initial purpose, but that doesn't call the feature itself into question. It's still perfectly functional and offers short quests that can be finished quickly. For the moment, we're not planning any changes to this system.

notes.title: EXPLORING WAVEN #2 - Deckbuilding
notes.notes:
[i]"In WAVEN, like in life, your thought process and your choices influence how you'll withstand the challenges that come your way.

You'll fight many battles, most of which will require you to adapt, but there's always a strategy that will bring you out the other side…"[/i]


[b]Tomo – a game designer at Ankama –[/b] guides you through the essence of understanding WAVEN gameplay. Every choice you make when [b]building your hero's deck[/b] will determine your [b]strategic approach[/b] on the battlefield against the various fearsome enemies you'll encounter there. To maximize your potential for [b]combos[/b] and [b]synergies[/b] in your deck, you'll need to acquire items, spells and companions throughout your adventure. Every quest will be full of pitfalls, and you'll need to [b]renew your tactics[/b] constantly to overcome the challenges waiting for you in WAVEN.

[previewyoutube=HAo1B9IVpVY;full][/previewyoutube]
This episode is available on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@WAVEN_GAME]our official YouTube channel[/url] in both English and French, with subtitles in English, French, German, Portuguese and Spanish.


[b]Keep your eyes on the horizon and look out for future episodes exploring other fascinating aspects of WAVEN![/b]

notes.title: EXPLORING WAVEN #1 - The Lore
notes.notes:
[i]"What would you do if an immense wave submerged the entire world and washed away everything you had?

How would you rebuild your home?

Would your life ever be the same again?

The heroes of WAVEN have asked themselves all of these questions, and the answers they came up with… well, let's just say they're far from perfect…"[/i]


In this inaugural episode, [b]Aurore – a narrative designer at Ankama[/b] – introduces you to the narrative background of a world filled with stories in which every secret that's revealed, every myth and every encounter will gradually bring you closer to the true essence of the World of Twelve in the WAVEN era. As its stories and legends come to life, WAVEN will begin to reveal some of the foundations of its [b]captivating narrative…[/b]
