notes.title: Check out the Lance Dur Season - Chapter 2: Belladonna
notes.notes:
[h1]Brambles Are Invading the Time Portal…[/h1]
The specter of Cire Momore is gone, and now it's time to face off against the one whose magic has bewitched so many unlucky adventurers over the centuries…  Like the flower of the same name, Belladonna is a beautiful as she is deadly, and her poison could be the death of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/94c56e9391654a0be13b02293904ba637cb7bc8f.png[/img]

Take up her challenge by heading to the portal on Competitive Island every day until December 19, try to resist her curse, and maybe you'll leave her lair covered in glory and treasure!

[h1]Fight Your Way to the Top of the Leaderboard[/h1]
The rankings are reset to zero with every new season, and everyone has a chance to come away with chests, Wakfu fragments and gems! Cunning and strategy will be decisive for victory. Will you be able to get out of the brambles or will you be another of Belladonna's hapless victims?

[h1]Finish the New Battle Pass Quests[/h1]
Every week, get new season goals to test your combat skills and collect Stars. These precious Stars open the doors to the Battle Pass rewards. Get free Wakfu fragments, gems and Albuera Chests by completing these challenges, which update every week!
The most faithful will be the best rewarded, because in addition to the weekly goas, 1,000 Wakfu fragments are available for free in the Shop every day! Spend them in Kabrok's shop to expand your spell decks and get rings, armbands and companions for the Lance Dur season!

[h1]Get Enchanting Cosmetic Items[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/0cbbf3acd3e7209c1ec781f30c2e94dc2f324d93.jpg[/img]

The Gold Pass and the Platinum Pass are now full of new cosmetic rewards that are as elegant as they are gloomy, like the shadowy Belladonna. Head to the WAVEN in-game shop to stand out from the back with:
[list]
[*] A brand-new Belladonna pet to accompany you on your quest.
[*] Visual effects to use in combat and in the world in WAVEN.
[*] A set of Belladonna emotes to enchant other adventurers.
[*] Companion skins to make your team as elegant as you.
[*] Belladonna speech bubbles.
[*] Season tickets to enter the witch's lair.
[*] And a multitude of gems to customize your WAVEN adventure even more!
[/list]
Each Battle Pass  has its own reward timeline, and the Platinum Pass unlocks them all! If you missed the start of the season, you can still collect all the rewards at any time, as long as you've got enough Stars.

All these rewards can only be unlocked in the Battle Pass  while Chapter 2: Belladonna lasts, so make sure you've unlocked everything before it's too late! And don't worry – if you've got enough Stars but you forget to collect your cosmetic rewards, they'll be waiting for you in an in-game letter when the next season begins. Season tickets, however, can only be used for the current chapter, so get ready to do battle!

[b]In Belladonna's lair, every flower could be lethal, and every thorn could contain a deadly poison. It's up to you to choose wisely…
[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.13.1
notes.notes:
[b]Note from the developers:[/b] [i]Patch 0.13.1 goes light on balancing. We wanted to observe the addition of Albuera content in the game as a whole before making changes to it. We're also considering reworking some of the heroes to give them more individualized identities and make them more playable. For now, however, we've focused on bug fixes and correcting undesired behaviors.[/i]

[u][b][h1]1. Classes and Heroes[/h1][/b][/u]
[h2]General[/h2]
[i]We've made a simple correction to the Albuera spells so that they all follow the same logic. These spells fall under the scope of our approach to strengthening magic, and we'll be paying close attention to their power between now and version 0.14.[/i]
[list]
[*] The Explosion/Peat/Hail/Rebound effects of Albueran spells are now properly affected by the ALBUERAN MAGIC effect.
[/list]

[h2]1.1. Cra[/h2]
[h3]1.1.1. Piven Bow[/h3]
[i]This hero had increased in power but was still weak compared to the other Cras. We're improving their basic passive to make them more versatile. The improvement increases damage, Water aura healing, and the power of companions' auras.[/i]

[u][b]Base passive:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] When your hero releases a DART AURA: Inflicts 60% of their ATTACK on the target.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] When your hero releases a DART AURA: Inflicts 60% of their ATTACK on the target. 30% of your ATTACK bonus is converted into an AURA BONUS.
[/list]
[h2]1.2. Sram[/h2]
[h3]1.2.1 Surokan Shiv[/h3]
[i]This hero was too powerful in version 0.13. We've lowered their power slightly.[/i]

[u][b]Hero Skill:[/b][/u]
[b]Surokan Mastery:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] When you trigger CONSPIRACY: +60% to your TRAP DAMAGE for the turn.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] When you trigger CONSPIRACY: +50% to your TRAP DAMAGE for the turn.
[/olist]

[h2]1.3. Xelor[/h2]
[h3]1.3.1. Pramium Catalyst[/h3]
[i]This hero had received major power additions plus quality of life improvements, which pushed them to the top of the meta. Consequently, we're lowering their power to rebalance them.[/i]

[u][b]Hero Skill:[/b][/u]
[b]Pramium Recycling:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] When you build a Sinistro: +2 gauges in the same element as the Sinistro.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] When you build a Sinistro: +1 gauge in the same element as the Sinistro.
[/list]

[h1]2. Items[/h1]
[i]Since the arrival of the Albuera Chests that can be obtained in any fight, we're replacing the "Albuera Finder" skill. The O'Lympic Ring has also been corrected and rebalanced.[/i]
[h2]2.1. Armbands[/h2]
[h3][u][b]Albuera Armband[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +10% health to your hero.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Ethereal Armband[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +10% to your spell DAMAGE.
[/list]

[h2]2.2. Rings[/h2]
[h3][u][b]Albuera Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill 1:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +1% ATTACK to your hero. +1% per equipment level.
[/list]
[b]Skill 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +3% chance of CRITICAL HITS with spells.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Wonmorgate Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +1% ATTACK to your hero. +1% per equipment level.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Skour Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +10% ATTACK to your hero.
[/list]
[u][b]Xymoron Ring[/b][/u]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +1% chance of finding one Albuera Chest.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +1% ATTACK to your companions. +1% per equipment level.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]O'Lympic Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The effect is now limited to 20 gauges generated.
[*] The item description has been improved to show the current bonus and the maximum bonus.
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] Your companions gain +5% ATTACK per gauge that you've generated during the fight.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] 4% ATTACK to your companions for each gauge that you generated during the fight.
[/list]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] Your companions gain +5% ATTACK per gauge that you've generated during the fight.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] +4% ATTACK extra to your companions per gauge that you've generated during the fight.
[/list]

[h2]2.3. Brooches[/h2]
[list]
[*] The brooch descriptions have been updated to clarify how they work and the rewards obtained.
[/list]

[h1]3. Companions[/h1]
[i]Biste is devastating when she repeats critical hits. We've therefore limited her power.[/i]
[h3][u][b]Biste[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] Critical: Replays turn.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] Replays turn. Limit: 2 times per turn.
[/list]
[i]Cesar's chest recovery skill has been transformed to give him a personalized skill.[/i]
[h3][u][b]Cesar[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Old effect:[/u] +2% chance of finding one SUPER EQUIPMENT CHEST.
[*] [u]New effect:[/u] SPAWN: +20% to your hero's ATTACK for the turn.
[/list]
[i]Suzy started out strong with the improvements made to this companion. We've rebalanced this companion.[/i]
[h3][u][b]Suzy[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Base attack: 25 → 20
[/list]

[h1]4. Fixes[/h1]
[h2]4.1. Classes and Heroes[/h2]
[h3][u][b]Spectral Armabladegeddon:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Soul Link[/b] skill no longer applies to opponents' spectral weapons.
[*] The [b]Assigned Volunteer[/b] spell properly gives the hero an amount of armor equal to the target's attack.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Stalaktoss Glaive:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Stalaktoss Armor[/b] and [b]Stalaktoss Spirit[/b] skills now properly count the targets that were gone through even if they die from dephasing damage.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Dephasing Gem:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Dephased Healing[/b], [b]Dephasing Concentration[/b] and [b]Spirit Heart[/b] skills now properly count the targets that were gone through even if they die from dephasing damage.
[*] The [b]Spirit Heart[/b] slab no longer heals opponents that walk on it.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Orishi Shears:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Orishi Power[/b] skill properly increases spell damage based on the number of traps on the field.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Surokan Shiv:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Surokan Shadow[/b] skill no longer activates if the opponent that triggers the Surokan Sliptrap does not have a free adjacent cell for the hero to be teleported to.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Tamashi Amber:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Tamashi Will[/b] skill properly gives the attack bonus per HEART AURA to all your companions and Nocturians in play, and not just to the hero.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Pramium Catalyst:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Pramium Revenge[/b] skill properly destroys the similar Sinistros already transformed and present on the field on the transformation of a Sinistro.
[*] The [b]Pramium Motivation[/b] skill no longer does damage to the summoned companion.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Apostruker Scalpel:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Apostruker Power[/b] skill no longer targets invulnerable enemies.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Pikuxala Hand:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Pikuxala Power[/b] skill no longer targets invulnerable enemies.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Xelor [b]Cog[/b] spell now shows a preview of the spell's damage area around all allied Sinistros on the field.
[*] The Iop [b]Race[/b] spell can no longer be cast on targets that can't move or have already finished their move.
[/list]

[h2]4.2. Items[/h2]
[h3][u][b]Skammer Armband[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The effect now applies even if the target dies from the attack.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]Limit Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer behavior fixed.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]O'Lympic Ring[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Attack boosts no longer apply to other allied players' companions.
[*] The Attack boosts for companions disappear after the death of the hero.
[/list]

notes.title: Check out the content of the Lance Dur Season – Chapter 1: Cire Momore!
notes.notes:
Halloween has come to the World of Twelve, and a new threat is knocking at the door in the form of Cire Momore. You can run. You can hide. But Cire Momore will find you. Now through November 21, this baleful specter is haunting WAVEN, bringing along candy that's full of surprises! 

[previewyoutube=K9SMVnhVHPE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Discover a New Competitive Game Mode
[/h1]The hunt has begun, and the confrontation is inevitable… A new time portal has opened in the World of Twelve, and the frightful Cire Momore is waiting for you on the other side, ready for a fight.
 
An all-new PvE game mode is now available on the new Competitive Island in WAVEN! Visit the time portal every day to take part in the fight – it is only available until November 21.

[h1]Climb to the Top of the Leaderboard
[/h1]Play as Count Lance Dur, a legend of the Krosmoz and the faithful representative of the Astramantis, fearsome warriors who wield devastating lances. You can preview playing as this brand-new hero in the time portal and discover all his spells, attacks, and passives!

Survive the onslaught of the dreadful Cire Momore and the Deathburns. Whether you try to run away or jump into the fray, you can't escape. But be one of the best adventurers, staying alive as long as possible, to walk away with a real treasure!

[h1]Unlock Unique Rewards and Strengthen Your Deck 
[/h1]At the end of Chapter 1, the best players on the leaderboard will receive chests, Wakfu Fragments, and gems to buy cosmetic items in WAVEN's in-game shop, such as character or companion skins, visual effects, and emotes!

And if you don't make it to the top 100, don't worry! All participants will go home with 500 Wakfu Fragments, which can be exchanged for brand-new Albuera Chests, adding new rings, armbands, spells, and companions to your decks. This new content will add even more possibilities to the game and let you discover completely new ways of playing your characters!

[h1]A Revamped Battle Pass
[/h1]This new seasons ushers in a new era for the WAVEN Battle Pass. Every week, you'll find new challenges – some linked to the time portal – that will earn you between 10 and 50 stars. Some challenges are harder than others, so they'll earn you more stars. These stars will build up, letting you access tiered battle pass rewards. So complete as many challenges as you can by playing WAVEN and walk away with valuable loot to help you in your adventure!

Gems, Albuera Chests, and Wakfu Fragments are available for free every week with the free battle pass, so what are you waiting for?

[h1]Exclusive Cosmetics Rewards
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/f295504474226fa9a769d9d0020fa404facf9def.jpg[/img]

Besides the free pass, changes have also been made to the Gold Pass and Platinum Pass, offering even more cosmetic content linked to Cire Momore! Get them in WAVEN's in-game shop now to receive:

[list]
[*] a Cire Momore's Candle pet that will follow you wherever you go;
[*] visual effects for combat and the hub to make other adventurers turn green with envy;
[*] a unique set of Cire Momore emotes;
[*] companion skins to customize how Lance Dur and his team look;
[*] new speech bubbles to communicate with other adventurers;
[*] season tickets to access the fight with Cire Momore, which will be added to your daily tickets to give you more opportunities to prove your worth in combat;
[*] and loads of gems to customize your adventure on the high seas even more!
[/list]
Each battle pass includes its own reward timeline, but the Platinum Pass unlocks them all! And if you missed the start of the season, you can still collect all the rewards at any time, as long as you've got enough stars.

All these rewards can only be unlocked in the Battle Pass while Chapter 1: Cire Momore lasts, so make sure you've unlocked everything before it's too late! And don't worry – if you've got enough stars but you forget to collect your cosmetic rewards, they'll be waiting for you in an in-game letter when the next season begins. Season tickets, however, can only be used for the current chapter, so get ready to do battle!

[h1]And Even More Content to Come!
[/h1]Cire Momore is just the first chapter in the three-month Lance Dur Season! Between now and mid-January, you'll find two more chapters, each offering new fights and challenges in the time portal, and you can enjoy two new battle passes, each with its own set of exceptional cosmetic rewards!

[b]Nobody escapes from Cire Momore, who's already taking aim at you… So fight Cire Momore in WAVEN now to try to walk away with that closely guarded treasure![/b]

notes.title: PIG SEASON
notes.notes:
Be as hard-snouted as the Pigs! Now through October 24, take part in this new monster season, where bacon and ninja are but one…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/c7321e2d910707ddaffbcea06f4cab2f0ec64ad0.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE WAY OF THE PIG
[/h1]Out of all the peoples, the Pigs have evolved particularly well. Angered at being treated like livestock, these swine have become extremely refined – they dress in the finest Hoghji Hamamoto attire, they've developed a most exacting fighting style, and they strive for success. In their quest to be the best, they've learned to enjoy fine cuisine – especially when Bontarians are on the menu – but out of all these efforts, none has been more grueling than refraining from letting one rip…

Anyhow, these fearsome warriors are waiting for just one thing: for you to come chop some pork on their island!

In this Pig Season, an imperial banquet awaits you in the new Combat Pass!

[h1]A NEW THEMED COMBAT PASS
[/h1]You can now find all the challenges and rewards you can unlock in the dedicated menu in the top-right corner of your screen.

Additional objectives are added every week, enabling you to progress with your Combat Pass. Win two fights to complete each objective and unlock your rewards!
 
[h1]FREE RESOURCES GALORE…
[/h1]In the Pig Season, you can get free rewards every week to help you on your adventure. Gems, kamas, super spell chests, companions, and equipment will be yours if you complete challenges!
 
[h1]… AND LOADS OF UNIQUE PIG COSMETICS![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/fa703ec9104bc810da91e32ec1cc9f19ccf77510.jpg[/img]

The Gold Pass and Platinum Pass are back! Get your Combat Pass now in the WAVEN in-game shop to unlock cosmetic content and useful resources every week, such as:

[list]
[*] a Little Pig pet in armor;
[*] visual effects reflecting your virtue in combat elsewhere in the World of Twelve;
[*] a new set of themed emotes;
[*] fun speech bubbles to interact with other castaways;
[*] and many other rewards that will help you on your adventure!
[/list]

Each Combat Pass includes its own series of rewards, but the Platinum Pass lets you unlock them all! And if you missed the start of the season, you can still collect all the rewards at any time, as long as you complete the related challenges.

All seasons last 28 days, so make sure you unlock everything by October 24, before it's too late! And rest assured, if you complete the challenges but you forget to collect your rewards, they'll be waiting for you in an in-game letter when the next season begins.

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.notes:
On August 31, we applied Patch 0.12.4, which reintroduced some in-game equipment that had previously been disabled for balancing reasons. We suspected that this update would receive a lukewarm reception. Let us explain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/b19882df08349af04c980339fc7964283616448d.png[/img]
  
When a game is released in [b]early access[/b], the main goal is to get feedback, suggestions, bug reports, and comments from players who [b]agree[/b] to venture into an [b]early version of the game that is still under development[/b]. The game's evolution and refinement can be seen here: WAVEN isn't yet available in its final ("Gold") version because it requires iterations to move toward the most accessible, stable, complete, and fun experience possible, thanks to you.

When we announced that early access would start on August 16, we made it clear that the experience wouldn't be complete and game content would evolve until the official release at the end of the year. This early access is an opportunity to contribute actively to the game's development process; this invitation is transparent and honest.

However, we fully understand the sense of dissatisfaction it can cause when reality catches up with us. It's frustrating to invest your free time in intensive gaming sessions, only to find that a balancing update means that your character or equipment no longer lives up to your expectations or no longer represents the hours of farming you've done. And this frustration is just as bad for us as it is for you.

We've read all your recent comments. We didn't speak out immediately because we still needed time to think and analyze the situation internally before we could provide you with accurate, coherent answers that met your expectations. Your reaction to the reintroduction of the previously disabled rings and armbands – proof of your attachment to the game, your characters, and their equipment – came as a bit of a shock. In all honesty, we hadn't considered a resource refund feature to be a priority, given the early-access nature of this version of the game. So, we decided to prioritize other features that were more enticing and important – fundamental, even.

[h3][b]We're dealing the cards again.[/b][/h3]

In a future WAVEN update, we'll be introducing a system whereby invested resources can be refunded. This system will be automatic and non-retroactive, and it won't be controlled by players. Here is a breakdown of the initial version of the feature:

[h2]System Structure[/h2]

When we make changes to equipment, spells, or heroes, [b]we will specify whether these changes will result in a refund of invested resources[/b]. These changes may take the form of balancing, an overhaul, or a temporary deactivation.

If the change results in a refund, an interface showing the changed equipment, spells, or heroes will appear in the game when you log in, listing each item that has changed.

[b]Refunded resources will be sent and stored directly in a letter[/b] (the envelope in the top-right corner of the screen) when the update is applied. You'll just need to [b]claim[/b] them for the resources to be reinvested. Stored resources will have no expiry date.

[h2]Possible Scenarios[/h2]

The various changes are as follows:
[list]
[*] The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been reworked;
[*] The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been rebalanced;
[*] The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been removed from the game;
[*] One of the item (equipment, companion, spell) skills has been reworked;
[*] One of the item (equipment, companion, spell) skills has been rebalanced;
[*] The hero's passive has been reworked;
[*] The hero's passive has been rebalanced;
[*] One of the upgrades for the hero's passive has been reworked;
[*] One of the upgrades for the hero's passive has been rebalanced;
[*] An Ether spell has been reworked; and
[*] An Ether spell has been rebalanced.
[/list]
  
Depending on the situation, the action may take the form of:
[list]
[*] A reset of the item (equipment, companion, spell) level to level 1;
[*] A recovery of the number of items (equipment, companions, spells) consumed to evolve it;
[*] A reset of the item (equipment, companion, spell) skill;
[*] A recovery of the runes invested in the item (equipment, companion, spell);
[*] A recovery of the kamas invested in the item (equipment, companion, spell); or
[*] No action.
[/list]

[h2]What Action(s) for What Situation?[/h2]

[b]The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] The item level is reset to level 1;
[*] The items consumed to evolve it are recovered;
[*] The item skills are reset;
[*] The runes invested in the item are recovered; and
[*] The kamas invested in the item are recovered.
[/list]

[b]The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] No action.
[/list]

[b]The item (equipment, companion, spell) has been removed from the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] The runes invested in the item are recovered; and
[*] The kamas invested in the item are recovered.
[/list]

[b]One of the item (equipment, companion, spell) skills has been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] The item skill is reset to level 1; and
[*] The runes invested in the item are recovered.
[/list]

[b]One of the item (equipment, companion, spell) skills has been rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] No action.
[/list]

[b]The hero's passive has been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero's skills are reset.
[/list]

[b]The hero's passive has been rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero's skills are reset.
[/list]

[b]One of the upgrades for the hero's passive has been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero's skills are reset.
[/list]

[b]One of the upgrades for the hero's passive has been rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero's skills are reset.
[/list]

[b]An Ether spell has been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] No action.
[/list]

[b]An Ether spell has been rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] No action.
[/list]

[h2]Why not make it possible to recover – in whole or in part – the resources invested in an item in exchange for a fee?[/h2]

We think that recovering resources invested in skills shouldn't be seen as a feature of convenience in the game, even in exchange for a fee. Allowing this would mean overstepping the Wakfu Fragments game plan. We prefer players to spend their time in dungeons and against monarchs rather than in interfaces, playing with investment, or resetting resources in their skills, even though theorycrafting is a core aspect of the game.

[h2]What Next?[/h2]

The initial balancing patches enabled us to quickly rectify combinations of items and skills that we considered to be too powerful. The goal behind this balancing wasn't to detract from the fun of some builds, but to [b]clean up the deckbuilding base[/b]. Some combinations enabled you to complete very high-level quests with builds that weren't supposed to enable this, not in the way we envisioned progress.

Also, the notion of balancing means that [b]we'll be reworking other combinations with little or insufficient power[/b] to enhance them. We want the balance to be as [b]fair and harmonious[/b] as possible. It's worth noting that further balancing patches are in the pipeline, and some of your heroes, equipment, spells, companions, etc. will also receive special attention over upcoming updates. Our analysis tools enable us to identify what combinations are being shunned by players, among other things. However, balancing is a medium- to long-term task in the life of a game, especially in a turn-based strategy game. So, this early access is a useful way of testing this aspect of the WAVEN development process.

We are looking forward to your feedback and comments, and we hope this system will enable you to make the most of your future theorycrafting and builds for your characters and items.

[b]The WAVEN Team[/b]

[h2]DOWNLOAD THE GAME[/h2]
An extraordinary and wonderfully colorful odyssey is waiting for you in WAVEN! The PC Early Access is finally available for download on the Ankama Launcher and Steam.
Choose your hero from among a range of captivating characters, get powerful spells, equipment and companions, and set sail for adventure on the high seas of WAVEN to become a legendary hero!

Early access involves putting an early version of a game that is still under development online. notes.title: Early Access Lifts Anchor on August 16!
notes.notes:
[h1]Land Ho, Castaways![/h1]

With a free early access period that's open to the public starting August 16, a game experience overflowing with content, strategy and challenges awaits you in WAVEN. A new take on the tactical RPG that's simple, dynamic, fun and immersive is now only a quick boat ride away! Whether you're a fan of tactical gameplay, deckbuilding, or just looking for an original and colorful world to explore, WAVEN offers brisk turn-based combat, multiple game modes, and plenty of secrets to discover… Prepare to set sail for an epic adventure and join the WAVEN community!

 

[h1]What Is WAVEN's Early Access Phase?[/h1]

Early access involves putting an early version of a game online while it is still under development. The goal is to get your feedback (suggestions, bug reports, comments, etc.) to refine and improve WAVEN before its official release, currently scheduled for late 2023. Early access is an opportunity to actively contribute to the game's evolution and its development process.

The early-access version of WAVEN will be incomplete, and its content may be subject to change before the official release. After that, WAVEN will continue to evolve with new content, patches, etc.

[h1]Content in the Early Access Version of WAVEN[/h1]

Play as one of the 25 heroes currently available, grouped into 5 classes (Cra, Eniripsa, Iop, Sram and Xelor)…
To write your legend, choose your character from a set of 25 heroes, each with a unique strategic approach and specific gameplay mechanics, passives and skills to let every player develop their own preferred gameplay style.

With the simplified hero selection interface, jump right into the action by choosing your starting character based on the archetypes you know and love from the RPG genre (archer, warrior, healer, assassin and mage).

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/abb392b250356b12939abefbd28f4e45fb2ae110.png[/img]
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/62287454c8ff31bb65881205ba3670bcf8c2bf16.jpg[/img]
  
[h2]Begin your initiation with a tutorial guided by Goultard![/h2]
Once you've selected your hero, the legendary Goultard will guide you through the tutorial island, the "Shushued Rift", to forge your first weapons and introduce you to the basic combat mechanics in fights against terrifying Shushus. The Goultard tutorial has been improved to provide a more immersive learning experience and help familiarize you more quickly with the subtleties of tactical combat!

[i]Prepare for the epic adventure ahead…[/i]
  
[h2]Sail off to new horizons and explore different archipelagos![/h2]
The island nation of Astrub will be your first port of call, where you'll take on your first introductory quests and start accumulating points to unlock the archipelagos of Amakna,* Bonta and Brakmar. Explore their magnificent landscapes and discover their many secrets, meet local residents to learn more about the history of the World of Twelve in the WAVEN era, complete their thirteen quests to obtain useful rewards for your deck, and even pause for a moment to immerse yourself in one of the island nations' exclusive concerts…

[i]* The island nation of Amakna will be inaccessible during WAVEN's early access phase. However, its monster islands (Gobballs, Taurs, Tofus) can be unlocked and accessed by boat.[/i]

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/9e436a87a554a2299cb35bb1aa06b202d0a4deae.jpg[/img]
  
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/aa7578cbcad1dec68001b52849347bb716506252.jpg[/img]
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/bb97170967d6b7cfd99d1b9ef53e73c0e0a0ad3f.jpg[/img]
  
  
 In addition to the introductory side quests, which have been updated to simplify your introduction to combat mechanics and better prepare you for the epic adventure that lies ahead, Astrub also offers two exclusive quests known as "clan quests", forming initial narrative threads that serve as a prologue to WAVEN's main storyline.* The entire game is dubbed in both English and French for a completely immersive experience.

[i]* The main storyline will be revealed when the game is officially released at the end of the year.[/i]

Challenges Abound in WAVEN…

[h2]Dominate the Monster Islands…[/h2]
The three archipelagos of Amakna, Bonta and Brakmar are each surrounded by three monster islands, and represent the last remaining vestiges of the former World of Twelve, now almost completely submerged under the waves.

Each island is controlled by a monster family with its own unique designs, challenges and dungeons. Land on these islands, face their challenges and level up your heroes! Obtain new equipment, spells and companions to build ever more powerful characters, and fine-tune your strategy while optimizing your deckbuilding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/1e2fe2b4dac456237b679851b66d9f2409c49412.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/4ad64ed96e71b8c02e33984e068f96db9757425e.png[/img]
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e4ec095d707a091963ac5a90a445894ac7efa1d5.png[/img]
[h2]…Or Be Dominated![/h2]
Add extra difficulty to your dungeon fights and enrich your strategic experience with brooches! Invite monarchs and elite monsters to the enemy team to add a bit of spice to your adventure. If you rise to their challenges, you can earn Wakfu that you can use to unlock special chests with exclusive rewards.
  

[h2]The Shushu Is in the Details[/h2]
Enigmatic prisms are scattered in hidden locations on the various monster islands. These prisms hold special, rare rewards. Explore, find them, and collect them all to become an illustrious explorer of WAVEN's islands!

[h2]Level Up Your Heroes and Their Skills…[/h2]
Each time you level up, assign skill points to your stats, class spells, hero spells or passive modifiers. Customize and optimize your character for maximum synergy with your ever-expanding deck! Reach the maximum level (level 50) to unlock your hero's full power and potential.

[h2]And track their progress in the World of Twelve![/h2]
Track your ongoing quests, discover unlockable achievements and the associated rewards, and measure all your accomplishments throughout your journey with your Logbook. Plus, in exchange for quest points, you can unlock all-new cosmetic items for your haven island, ship, and more!
  

[h2]There's Greater Glory in Numbers[/h2]
Prepare to take on even more thrilling challenges when you tackle WAVEN's different quests with a group. Form groups of up to 3 players with your friends or other castaways, and battle your way to cooperative victories to earn additional rewards. Each fight offers a group challenge, for which victory or failure will impact your entire party.

[i]Legends are never written alone…
[/i]
Face Off Against the Toughest Castaways
The "Kolossium" PvP island welcomes all players looking to put their deckbuilding and tactical skills to the test in one-on-one battles. In the arena, all heroes are level 1, no equipment is available, and all spells and companions are unlocked, so you'll have to rely on strategy and careful planning to emerge victorious!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/29edbda0d41d6bfc8a876eac5fefbe23fa07f62a.jpg[/img] 


[h2]Save Your Progress Wherever Your Odyssey Takes You![/h2]
Continue your adventure right where you left off, whether on PC or Mac, with Ankama Launcher or Steam – and soon on mobile devices and tablets too, when the game is officially released at the end of this year. Your progress will be saved* from this early access phase, and you'll keep it even after WAVEN's official release!

[i]* If required by exceptional circumstances, we reserve the right to perform a server reset or rollback.[/i]

notes.title: Check out the WAVEN demo !
notes.notes:
This demo version offers an overview of what you'll discover in the early access stage planned for this summer. It's primarily aimed at new players – and international players as well, with the whole game translated for the first time from French into four other languages: English, German, Spanish and Portuguese. Therefore, we intentionally wanted to limit the demo to a beginner-oriented experience. For the early access this summer, the content will of course continue to evolve.

[h2]Play as one of 25 available heroes, grouped into 5 classes (Cra, Eniripsa, Iop, Sram and Xelor)…[/h2]
Each hero has a unique set of skills that offer a different strategic approach, allowing every player to find their preferred gameplay style.

[h2]And to ensure smooth sailing for the demo, we've included a simplified hero selection interface![/h2]
When you first enter the game, you'll be welcomed by a simplified hero selection interface, designed with new players in mind. Each class is represented by a pre-selected hero belonging to a well-known archetype from the RPG genre (archer, warrior, healer, assassin and mage). However, the classic interface will also still be available for more experienced castaways.


    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/62287454c8ff31bb65881205ba3670bcf8c2bf16.jpg[/img]


[h2]Goultard is your guide.[/h2]
Once you've selected your hero, the legendary Iop demi-god Goultard will welcome you to the tutorial island, the "Shushued Rift", to forge your starting weapons and help you understand the basics of the combat mechanics by taking on a few monstrous opponents.
After the tutorial is finished, set sail for the start of an epic adventure in a world partly submerged under the waves…
 
[h2]The island nation of Astrub, your first port of call…[/h2]
Begin by exploring the island nation of Astrub, a key destination in your journey. Meet its inhabitants and learn more about the history of the World of Twelve in the WAVEN era. Discover its magnificent landscapes and a few of its secrets, interact with amusing and endearing NPCs, and enjoy an exclusive concert by French artist Canine!

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/acd44018bb9fa0cc57e7ddfba0f1ce4c2e2e0051.jpg[/img]
  
[h2]Quests and Monster Islands[/h2]
Complete the eight quests available on Astrub Island to collect valuable quest points and unlock the neighboring monster islands: Chafer, Pig and Taur. Monster islands are the last remaining vestiges of the old World of Twelve, now submerged under the sea. These three monster islands are only a preview of the final content (9 will be available when the game is released, in addition to the island nations).

Each island is controlled by a monster family with its own unique designs, challenges and dungeons. Land on these islands, face their challenges and level up your heroes! Obtain new equipment and spells to build ever more powerful characters, and fine-tune your strategy while optimizing your deckbuilding.

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/1e2fe2b4dac456237b679851b66d9f2409c49412.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/4ad64ed96e71b8c02e33984e068f96db9757425e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/e4ec095d707a091963ac5a90a445894ac7efa1d5.png[/img]

[h2]Level up your heroes and their skills…[/h2]
For this demo version of WAVEN, level up your hero to level 20, the highest level achievable during this period. We're also introducing the Skills system to let you customize and optimize your character for your own unique play style.
Your hero's progress will not be saved when the server closes (June 26, 2023 at 7 p.m. CEST). For the early access this summer, your account will therefore be reset.
 
[h2]… And track their progress in the World of Twelve![/h2]
Track your ongoing quests, discover unlockable achievements and the associated rewards, and measure all your accomplishments throughout your journey with your Logbook. Plus, in exchange for quest points, you can unlock all-new cosmetic items!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/b7df9e3bc3e52a5019343c0edcc68f823dac2823.jpg[/img]  

[h2]Face off against the toughest castaways![/h2]
The "Kolossium" PvP island welcomes all players looking to put their deckbuilding and tactical skills to the test in one-on-one battles. In the arena, all heroes and equipment are level 1 and all spells are unlocked, so you'll have to rely on strategy and careful planning to emerge victorious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049144/29edbda0d41d6bfc8a876eac5fefbe23fa07f62a.jpg[/img]
  

[h2]What happens when I reach the maximum level?[/h2]
Once you've reached level 20, you will no longer be able to participate in PvE activities. However, the Kolossium will still be accessible. You can also create new heroes to test other gameplay styles and revisit the monster islands to complete any remaining challenges!
The whole team is eagerly looking forward to seeing you dive (back) into the world of WAVEN with this demo version. Prepare to experience epic adventure, (re)discover a thrilling world, and confront hordes of increasingly powerful monsters.

Steam Next Fest is an excellent opportunity to get initial feedback from players on Steam about our next release. Your comments and feedback are very important to us, and help us to make WAVEN the best it can be!

Thanks to all the castaways who'll be joining the adventure, and to everyone who's working hard to get the game ready for release.

We can't wait to experience this thrilling voyage with you!
